66369.recognize_zh: 細胞豐富的骨髓抹片背景中，散在大量大小一致的小圓形至橢圓形體，每顆有透明暈與偏一側的紫色小點，並在下方聚成一大團（多為破裂組織球釋出的菌體）；這種成群小酵母加透明暈，是組織漿菌感染骨髓的典型所見。
features: Numerous uniform small round-to-oval yeast forms (about 2-4 um) with clear halos and an eccentric purple dot or crescent
Dense aggregate of yeasts in the lower center, likely released from a disrupted histiocyte, plus many scattered extracellular forms
Occasional forms appear paired, suggestive of budding
Cellular aspirate with erythroid precursors, myeloid precursors, and cells with plasmacytoid features in the background
Scattered fat vacuoles and fine purple granular background debris/platelets
66369.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with erythroid and granulocytic precursors, occasional plasmacytoid cells, and scattered fat vacuoles. Numerous small, uniform round-to-oval organisms measuring approximately 2-4 um are present, each with a clear halo and an eccentric crescent or dot of purple-staining cytoplasm. The organisms are scattered extracellularly and form a dense aggregate in the lower center, consistent with release from a disrupted histiocyte; occasional paired forms suggest budding. No kinetoplasts are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by disseminated histoplasmosis, and confirmation by GMS stain, culture, or antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a rod-shaped kinetoplast adjacent to the nucleus and lack a clear halo; they are GMS-negative.
Talaromyces yeasts are more pleomorphic and elongated with a central transverse septum (fission rather than budding).
Tachyzoites are crescentic with a central nucleus and no halo, and are GMS-negative.
Platelets are irregular granular fragments without a sharply defined clear halo and eccentric crescent.

66177.recognize_zh: 數顆異常早幼粒細胞的核呈雙葉或摺疊狀（蝴蝶翅膀／bilobed），胞質淡灰藍、顆粒稀少或僅見細塵狀顆粒；另有兩三顆細胞胞質內充滿粗大紫紅顆粒遮住核，符合 hypogranular（微顆粒型）急性前骨髓細胞白血病。
features: Medium-to-large cells with bilobed, folded or reniform ('butterfly-wing') nuclei
Fine chromatin with occasional indistinct nucleoli
Pale gray-blue cytoplasm that is hypogranular or contains only fine dust-like granules, with irregular pseudopod-like borders
Interspersed cells packed with coarse purple-red granules obscuring the nucleus (hypergranular promyelocytes)
No definite Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) seen in this field; background red cells unremarkable
66177.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of abnormal promyelocytes, many with bilobed or folded nuclei resembling butterfly wings, fine chromatin and pale gray-blue hypogranular cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules. Several interspersed cells are packed with coarse purple-red granules that obscure the nuclear outline. No faggot cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypogranular (microgranular) variant; PML::RARA confirmation should be obtained urgently and ATRA started on morphologic suspicion given the coagulopathy risk.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei too but more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles, strong nonspecific esterase activity and usually HLA-DR/CD11b/CD14 positivity, whereas APL is HLA-DR-negative and strongly MPO-positive.
NPM1-mutated AML can be CD34-/HLA-DR- with nuclear invaginations but lacks bilobed hypergranular promyelocytes and PML::RARA.
Normal-looking promyelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with a Golgi hof and orderly granules, and are accompanied by maturing myelocytes rather than a monotonous bilobed population.

66113.recognize_zh: 上下兩個視野中，箭頭所指的紅血球明顯比周圍大、呈飽滿的卵圓形且中央淡染區消失，這就是巨卵圓形紅血球（macro-ovalocyte）；背景還有許多卵圓形與少數淚滴狀紅血球，提示巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Scattered red cells distinctly larger than neighbors with a full oval shape (macro-ovalocytes, arrows)
Macro-ovalocytes are well hemoglobinized with little or no central pallor
Background anisopoikilocytosis with many oval/elliptical forms and occasional teardrop and irregular cells
No polychromasia, red cell inclusions or leukocytes in these fields; scattered platelets
66113.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (two fields) shows anisopoikilocytosis with numerous oval and elliptical red cells and occasional teardrop forms. Scattered macro-ovalocytes (arrows) are larger than surrounding red cells, fully hemoglobinized and lack central pallor. No polychromasia or red cell inclusions are seen. Findings are suggestive of megaloblastic change; macro-ovalocytes can be present even when the MCV is normal (e.g., coexisting iron deficiency or thalassemia trait), so B12 and folate levels should be checked.

ddx.vs: Non-megaloblastic macrocytes are round, often with target cells or polychromasia, whereas macro-ovalocytes are distinctly oval and fully hemoglobinized.
Elliptocytes are normocytic, more elongated with parallel sides and dominate the smear, rather than scattered enlarged oval cells.
MDS can show identical macro-ovalocytes but has normal B12/folate and dysplasia in neutrophils or cytopenias, requiring marrow evaluation.

65793.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大型多形性淋巴瘤細胞呈線狀與團塊排列在竇腔內（PAX5 勾勒出竇內分佈），且 cyclin D1、SOX11、p53 強陽性；抹片上是胞質嗜鹼性的大型不規則細胞，這是多形性被套細胞淋巴瘤而非血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Large pleomorphic lymphoma cells with irregular vesicular nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, arranged in cords and clusters within dilated sinusoids
Aspirate: large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, moderately condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with occasional blebs
PAX5 highlights intrasinusoidal linear and nodular clusters of B cells, with background hematopoiesis negative
Strong diffuse nuclear cyclin D1 in the same intrasinusoidal population
Strong nuclear p53 overexpression in most tumor cells, suggesting TP53 mutation
SOX11 nuclear positivity of variable intensity
65793.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows infiltration by large, pleomorphic atypical lymphoid cells distributed predominantly within sinusoids as linear cords and cohesive intravascular clusters. The aspirate smear contains large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm. By immunohistochemistry the neoplastic cells are positive for PAX5, cyclin D1 and SOX11 and show strong p53 overexpression; the PAX5 stain accentuates the intrasinusoidal pattern. Findings are consistent with relapsed pleomorphic mantle cell lymphoma with an intrasinusoidal pattern of marrow involvement, a pattern that can mimic intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: IVLBCL shows similar intrasinusoidal large B cells but is cyclin D1- and SOX11-negative and lacks IGH::CCND1.
SMZL also favors an intrasinusoidal pattern but consists of small cells that are cyclin D1- and SOX11-negative.
Occasional DLBCL expresses weak cyclin D1 but is SOX11-negative and lacks CCND1 rearrangement, whereas here cyclin D1 is strong and uniform.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with CCND1 translocation
ddx.vs: Myeloma cells are cyclin D1-positive but PAX5-negative and CD138-positive, unlike these PAX5-positive B cells.

65793.stain: H&E; Wright-Giemsa; IHC: PAX5, cyclin D1, p53, SOX11

65665.recognize_zh: 頭顱正位與側位 X 光片上整個顱穹窿布滿大量小而邊界清楚、無硬化邊緣的圓形透亮溶骨病灶（punched-out lesions，俗稱 raindrop / pepper-pot skull），是多發性骨髓瘤的典型影像。
features: Plain radiographs of the skull, anteroposterior and lateral views (same pair shown twice)
Innumerable small, round, well-defined radiolucent lesions throughout the calvarium
Lesions lack a sclerotic rim or periosteal reaction ('punched-out' appearance)
Diffuse distribution involving frontal, parietal and occipital bones; no single dominant expansile mass evident
65665.describe_en: Anteroposterior and lateral plain radiographs of the skull demonstrate innumerable small, well-circumscribed, round lytic lesions diffusely involving the calvarium, without sclerotic margins or periosteal reaction. No large expansile lesion is identified at this resolution. This punched-out ('raindrop') pattern is characteristic of plasma cell myeloma, although correlation with serum/urine protein studies and bone marrow examination is required. Findings are consistent with multiple myeloma bone disease.

ddx.vs: Metastases are usually fewer, more variable in size with irregular margins, and the primary tumor or cytokeratin-positive marrow disease identifies them.
Shows fine granular mottled demineralization rather than discrete punched-out lesions, with elevated PTH and calcium.
Usually fewer, larger lesions with bevelled edges ('hole-within-a-hole') in younger patients, with CD1a/langerin-positive cells on biopsy.

65345.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大型巨噬細胞的細胞質塞滿大量大小一致、約 2–4 µm 的小圓點狀微生物（Leishman-Donovan bodies），整片呈泡沫狀，符合內臟利什曼原蟲症。
features: Sheets of enlarged macrophages with pale, vacuolated cytoplasm
Innumerable small, uniform, round to oval intracellular organisms (about 2 to 4 µm) packing the macrophage cytoplasm
Organisms show a dark dot-like nucleus; kinetoplast not resolvable at this resolution
Some organisms appear extracellular, likely released from disrupted macrophages
Scattered dense lymphoid/stromal nuclei; hematopoietic elements markedly reduced in this field
65345.describe_en: H&E-stained section of a bone marrow trephine shows sheets of enlarged macrophages whose vacuolated cytoplasm is packed with numerous small, uniform, round intracellular organisms, with some apparently extracellular forms. The kinetoplast cannot be clearly resolved on this H&E section, and residual hematopoiesis is sparse in this field. The appearance of parasitized macrophages is consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies of visceral leishmaniasis. Confirmation by Giemsa-stained aspirate showing the nucleus and bar-shaped kinetoplast, CD1a immunostain, culture or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Yeasts are similar in size but lack a kinetoplast, show a pseudocapsular halo, and are GMS and PAS positive, whereas amastigotes are GMS negative.
Yeast-like cells divide by a central septum (fission) and stain with GMS, without a kinetoplast.
Tachyzoites are crescent-shaped and lack a kinetoplast, and are identified by Toxoplasma immunostain.
Morphologically identical, so geography, tissue tropism (cardiac muscle) and serology or PCR are required.

65089.recognize_zh: 低倍下一個萎縮的生發中心呈粉紅、玻璃樣外觀，淋巴球稀少，內含核大且淡染的濾泡樹突細胞與穿入的小血管，外圍被一圈圈同心排列的小淋巴球（洋蔥皮狀 mantle zone）包住；這是透明血管型單中心性 Castleman 病的典型濾泡。
features: Regressed, lymphocyte-depleted germinal center with eosinophilic hyaline-appearing stroma
Germinal center composed of follicular dendritic cells with enlarged pale vesicular and irregular nuclei plus endothelial cells
Small vessel penetrating into the germinal center
Expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin layers
Interfollicular region at left with increased vessels and spindle stromal cells
65089.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows a follicle with a small, regressed germinal center that is depleted of lymphocytes and composed of eosinophilic stroma, endothelial cells and follicular dendritic cells with enlarged, vesicular, irregular nuclei. A small vessel penetrates the germinal center. The surrounding mantle zone is expanded, with small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric rings, and the interfollicular area is vascular. Findings are consistent with unicentric Castleman disease, hyaline-vascular type.

ddx.vs: HIV-associated follicle lysis and involution can mimic regressed germinal centers but usually lacks prominent onion-skin mantles and occurs with clinical HIV infection.
AITL shows regressed follicles with expanded FDC meshworks but has an atypical clear-cell T-cell infiltrate with PD1/CXCL13 expression and arborizing high endothelial venules.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma with mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mantle cells are cyclin D1+/CD5+ and slightly irregular, while the germinal centers are usually reactive rather than hyalinized.

65153.recognize_zh: 腹水中一團立體、細胞彼此擠壓的大型細胞，部分細胞質含大型淡染空泡並把深染細胞核推向邊緣形成新月形，與間皮細胞或巨噬細胞不同，符合轉移性印戒細胞腺癌。
features: Three-dimensional cohesive cluster (morula-like ball) of large atypical cells
Pale, finely vacuolated to clear intracytoplasmic vacuoles in several cells
Round to crescentic hyperchromatic nuclei pushed to the cell periphery by vacuoles
High nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio in non-vacuolated cells with nuclear overlap
Clean background with scant debris
65153.describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows a tight three-dimensional cluster of large atypical cells in a clean background. Several cells contain large pale intracytoplasmic vacuoles that compress hyperchromatic nuclei into eccentric crescents, while the remaining cells have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios with nuclear overlap. Nucleoli are not well assessed because of the dense staining. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma with signet ring cell features.

ddx.vs: Reactive mesothelial cells form flat sheets or small clusters with central nuclei, dense peripheral cytoplasm and intercellular windows, and are calretinin/WT1/D2-40 positive rather than MOC-31/BerEP4 positive.

Lobular carcinoma also shows intracytoplasmic mucin (targetoid) vacuoles but typically presents as single cells or linear chains; GATA3/ER positivity and E-cadherin loss distinguish it from gastric-type signet ring carcinoma (CDX2/CK20).
Macrophages lie singly with small bean-shaped nuclei and multiple fine vacuoles without nuclear atypia or three-dimensional cohesion.

65025.recognize_zh: 三格周邊血抹片中布滿大小接近紅血球的小淋巴球，核圓、染色質呈粗塊狀（soccer-ball / 龜殼樣）、細胞質極少，左格可見一團被推擠破碎的核影（smudge cells），符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）。
features: Increased small mature lymphocytes, about 1-1.5 times the diameter of a red cell
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue cytoplasm
Round nuclei with coarsely clumped, block-like chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
A few cells with slightly irregular or indented nuclear contours
Smudge (basket) cells in the left panel
Red cells normochromic; no significant schistocytes; platelets present
65025.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an absolute lymphocytosis composed predominantly of small mature lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm, round nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin without prominent nucleoli. Smudge cells are present. Prolymphocytes with prominent nucleoli are not conspicuous in these fields. In conjunction with flow cytometry showing a CD19+/CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population, findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: MCL cells are often more irregular/cleaved with less clumped chromatin and are CD5+ but CD23-negative with cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia or CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are larger with moderately condensed chromatin and a single prominent central nucleolus, which are not prominent here.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone / splenic marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: SMZL cells may have villous cytoplasmic projections and are usually CD5-negative and CD23-negative.
Reactive lymphocytes are polyclonal, often with more cytoplasm or cleaved nuclei in children, and lack light-chain restriction.

64897.recognize_zh: 六格圖中的淋巴樣細胞呈中等大小，核圓、染色質中度濃縮並有一顆清楚的中央核仁，胞質淡藍且邊緣有不規則毛狀突起，外觀介於前淋巴球（prolymphocyte）與毛細胞之間，符合具明顯核仁的脾臟 B 細胞淋巴瘤／白血病（SBLPN）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin with a single conspicuous central nucleolus
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Irregular, fine hair-like cytoplasmic projections on several cells
Relatively monomorphic population across panels; background red cells with occasional crenation
64897.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and a single prominent nucleolus, with a moderate amount of pale basophilic cytoplasm bearing irregular villous or hair-like projections. The morphology is intermediate between prolymphocytes and hairy cells. In the context of leukocytosis and splenomegaly, and with immunophenotyping negative for CD25, CD123, annexin A1, and TRAP, findings are consistent with splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (formerly hairy cell leukemia variant).

ddx.vs: Classic HCL cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with inconspicuous nucleoli and usually present with monocytopenia and leukopenia, and are CD25+, CD123+, annexin A1+ with BRAF V600E.
SMZL villous lymphocytes are smaller with polar short villi and lack a prominent nucleolus.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic transformation of CLL / prolymphocytoid lymphoma
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes share the prominent nucleolus but have smooth cytoplasmic borders without hairy projections; CLL phenotype (CD5+, CD23+) may be evident.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, leukemic pleomorphic variant
ddx.vs: Nuclear contours are more irregular and the cells are CD5+ with cyclin D1 or SOX11 expression.

64769.recognize_zh: 骨髓腔完全被纖維化間質取代，內含大小不一的上皮細胞巢，部分巢中央細胞質嗜酸性明亮並呈同心圓排列（角化傾向），加上周邊造血細胞消失，符合轉移性鱗狀細胞癌。
features: Complete replacement of the intertrabecular marrow by desmoplastic fibrous stroma with scattered fat spaces
Variably sized nests of cohesive epithelial cells, some large with central dense eosinophilic cytoplasm and concentric (whorled) arrangement suggesting squamous differentiation/keratinization
Smaller nests and cords of basaloid-appearing cells with hyperchromatic nuclei
No residual hematopoietic cells in this field; adjacent thin bone trabecula
64769.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows the intertrabecular space replaced by a desmoplastic fibrous stroma containing numerous infiltrating nests and cords of cohesive epithelial cells. Several larger nests show abundant dense eosinophilic cytoplasm with a whorled arrangement suggestive of squamous differentiation, while smaller nests are composed of cells with hyperchromatic nuclei. Normal hematopoietic elements are absent in this field. The findings are consistent with metastatic squamous cell carcinoma involving the bone marrow, in keeping with the known primary.

ddx.vs: Adenocarcinoma shows gland/lumen formation or mucin rather than squamous whorls with dense eosinophilic keratinizing cytoplasm, and is p40-negative.
Urothelial carcinoma may show squamous differentiation but is GATA3/uroplakin positive, and clinical history of a laryngeal/esophageal primary favors squamous carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Post-treatment marrow fibrosis with osteoblast clusters
ddx.vs: Reactive fibrosis contains bland osteoblasts along bone surfaces rather than infiltrative nests of atypical cytokeratin-positive cells.

64449.recognize_zh: 整個視野紅血球嚴重大小不一與變形：大量雪茄狀橢圓形紅血球，加上碎片、小球形與出芽狀的微小紅血球碎塊，細胞整體偏小，在嬰兒要想到遺傳性熱變形紅血球症（HPP）。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous elongated elliptocytes and cigar-shaped cells
Abundant red cell fragments, microspherocytes, and budding/irregular poikilocytes
Occasional teardrop cells and schistocytes
Microcytic red cells overall; few hypochromic cells
An eosinophil and one elongated nucleated cell present; dark stain precipitate scattered across the smear
Platelets appear adequate
64449.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis dominated by elliptocytes and cigar-shaped red cells, with many red cell fragments, microspherocytes, bizarre budding poikilocytes, and occasional teardrop cells. Red cells are predominantly microcytic, with a few hypochromic forms. An eosinophil is present, platelets are adequate, and dark stain precipitate is noted as artifact. In an infant with hemolytic anemia, findings are consistent with hereditary pyropoikilocytosis, a severe variant of hereditary elliptocytosis; thermal sensitivity testing, EMA binding, or spectrin gene analysis can confirm.

ddx.vs: Common HE shows uniform elliptocytes with little fragmentation or microspherocytosis and usually mild or no anemia.
Burn-related red cell fragmentation and microspherocytes are acquired and occur with a history of severe burns rather than in a well infant.
MAHA shows helmet cells and schistocytes with thrombocytopenia rather than a predominant elliptocyte population with normal platelets.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency or thalassemia with pencil cells
ddx.vs: Pencil cells in iron deficiency are hypochromic without abundant microspherocytes and budding fragments, and iron studies or hemoglobin analysis separate them.

64385.recognize_zh: PAS 染色下，大量未成熟紅血球母細胞的細胞質內出現粗大、塊狀或球狀的洋紅色陽性顆粒（chunky globular pattern），部分細胞呈瀰漫強陽性，這種異常模式支持急性紅血球白血病。
features: Cluster of immature cells with round nuclei and moderate cytoplasm in a PAS-stained aspirate smear
Coarse granular to chunky globular magenta PAS positivity in the cytoplasm of many cells
Some cells with intense, confluent block-like PAS staining obscuring the cytoplasm
Other cells PAS-negative or with only faint fine granules, giving a heterogeneous pattern
Pink PAS-positive background with outlines of red cells
64385.describe_en: PAS stain of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows an aggregate of immature cells, many of which display coarse granular to chunky globular magenta cytoplasmic positivity, with several cells showing intense confluent block-like staining. Other cells in the cluster are negative or faintly positive. Lineage cannot be established on the PAS stain alone, but in the context of erythroblasts on the Romanowsky stain this abnormal globular PAS pattern is consistent with neoplastic erythropoiesis, as seen in acute erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts show coarse PAS block positivity on a clear cytoplasmic background as well, so immunophenotyping (CD71/E-cadherin/glycophorin versus TdT/CD19/CD3) is required to separate them.
Non-neoplastic erythroblasts are usually PAS-negative or only faintly diffusely positive, and megaloblastic cells lack the chunky globular pattern and respond to B12/folate.
MDS may show PAS-positive erythroblasts but has fewer than 30% proerythroblasts with less than 80% erythroid cells, which requires counting on the Romanowsky smear.
Megakaryoblasts may show PAS positivity with cytoplasmic blebs, but they express CD41/CD61 rather than erythroid markers.

64129.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血細胞與脂肪之間夾雜成片大型細胞，細胞質淡染、呈細網狀或泡泡狀（bubbly），核小而居中或偏位，為泡沫狀巨噬細胞浸潤，提示儲積症（如 Niemann-Pick）。
features: Sheets and clusters of large polygonal macrophages interspersed among hematopoietic cells and adipocytes
Abundant pale cytoplasm with fine reticulated, bubbly (multivacuolated) texture
Small round to oval, centrally or eccentrically placed nuclei
Sharp cell borders giving a mosaic pattern where macrophages are confluent
Residual hematopoietic cells including erythroid and myeloid precursors and a megakaryocyte
64129.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow in which the hematopoietic elements are extensively infiltrated by sheets of large macrophages. These cells have abundant pale, finely vacuolated bubbly cytoplasm with distinct borders and small central to eccentric nuclei. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis and fat spaces are present. Findings are consistent with infiltration by foamy storage histiocytes, suggestive of a lipid storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease; correlation with aspirate morphology, enzyme assay, and genetic testing is required.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells on trephine have striated, fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm that is PAS-positive, rather than finely bubbly vacuoles.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes have striated/granular pale cytoplasm and are packed with acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Carcinoma cells show nuclear atypia with nucleoli, form cohesive nests with delicate vasculature, and are cytokeratin positive and CD68/CD163 negative.

ddx.dx: Crystal-storing or lipid-laden histiocytosis in lymphoproliferative disorders
ddx.vs: These show crystalline or eosinophilic inclusions with an associated clonal lymphoid or plasma cell population.

64065.recognize_zh: 兩顆相鄰的母細胞（blast），核質比高、染色質細緻；右側細胞核旁有一個淡染的杯狀凹陷（cup-like invagination），細胞質內可見多條細長的 Auer 小體（Auer rods），符合伴杯狀母細胞的急性骨髓性白血病（AML）。
features: Two large blasts molded against each other, several times the size of adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with fine, dispersed chromatin
Right cell: pale, clear nuclear invagination creating a cup-like/fish-mouth appearance
Multiple slender, rod-shaped linear inclusions consistent with Auer rods overlying the cells
Scant pale cytoplasm at the cell edges; background normochromic red cells and a few platelets
64065.describe_en: Peripheral blood (or aspirate) smear shows two large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and finely dispersed chromatin. One blast has a pale cup-like nuclear invagination, and multiple slender linear inclusions consistent with Auer rods are present. The cells are closely apposed and molded, and no maturing granulocytes are seen in this field. Image focus limits assessment of nucleoli and granules. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with NPM1 mutation and/or FLT3-ITD.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or butterfly nuclei with heavy azurophilic granules or faggot bundles of Auer rods, and PML::RARA must be excluded urgently when multiple Auer rods are seen.
Lymphoblasts never contain Auer rods, which establish myeloid lineage.
t(8;21) blasts have a single long slender Auer rod, salmon-colored perinuclear granules and a prominent hof with maturing neutrophils, rather than cup-like invaginations.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and rarely Auer rods, and are nonspecific esterase positive.

64001.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中皮膚上有兩條平行、細長弧形且略為隆起的淡紅色條狀斑塊，呈鞭痕樣排列，在 ABVD 化療後出現，符合 bleomycin 引起的鞭狀皮膚炎。
features: Two parallel, elongated curvilinear raised plaques
Pink-erythematous to violaceous color with a glossy surface
Whip-mark (flagellate) linear configuration
Surrounding skin intact without vesicles, scale, or excoriation
64001.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows two parallel, elongated, curvilinear, mildly raised pink-erythematous plaques on otherwise unremarkable skin, arranged in a whip-mark configuration. There are no vesicles, crusts, erosions, or scale. Histologic features cannot be assessed from this clinical image. In a patient treated with ABVD for Hodgkin lymphoma, the flagellate pattern is consistent with bleomycin-induced flagellate dermatitis.

ddx.vs: Dermatographic urticaria is transient and reproducible by stroking the skin, whereas bleomycin lesions persist for weeks and leave hyperpigmentation.
Morphology is similar, so history of raw shiitake mushroom ingestion rather than bleomycin exposure separates them.

ddx.dx: Linear lichen planus or other koebnerized dermatosis
ddx.vs: Koebnerized lichen planus shows flat-topped violaceous polygonal papules with Wickham striae rather than smooth erythematous streaks.

63809.recognize_zh: PD-L1 免疫染色中，大部分大型腫瘤細胞呈強而完整的棕色細胞膜與細胞質陽性，形成網狀外觀，僅少數區域較淡，屬於 PD-L1 高度表現，常見於具霍奇金特徵的縱膈淋巴瘤。
features: Strong, diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic PD-L1 staining in the majority of large tumor cells
Complete circumferential membrane staining producing a honeycomb/chicken-wire pattern
Tumor nuclei appear as pale, unstained round spaces within the brown staining
Occasional small, intensely positive dot-like or cellular foci, possibly macrophages or cross-cut membranes
Focal areas with weaker staining at the right upper field
63809.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for PD-L1 shows strong, diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic staining in the majority of large tumor cells, producing a honeycomb pattern around unstained nuclei, with only focal areas of weaker staining. Admixed histiocytes may contribute to some of the positivity, which cannot be fully separated at this resolution. High PD-L1 expression is characteristic of lymphomas with 9p24.1 (PD-L1/PD-L2) alterations, including classic Hodgkin lymphoma, primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma and mediastinal gray zone lymphoma, and provides a rationale for PD-1 blockade.

ddx.vs: Usually shows PD-L1 in only a minority of tumor cells, with positivity largely confined to tumor-associated macrophages.
PD-L1-positive macrophages have smaller, bean-shaped nuclei and irregular cytoplasm, and double staining with PAX5 or CD68 separates them.
Also frequently strongly PD-L1 positive; distinction from gray zone lymphoma rests on morphology and CD15/CD30/CD20 profile rather than PD-L1.

63745.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中小淋巴球明顯增加，染色質塊狀、胞質極少（綠箭頭），混有胞質較多且核偏心的漿細胞樣淋巴球（紅箭頭）與非典型漿細胞（黑箭頭）；低倍（A）圈起處為深紫色顆粒充滿的肥大細胞增加，這組合是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤骨髓的典型表現。
features: Cellular particles/trails with increased small lymphocytes having clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm (green arrow)
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm (red arrow)
Atypical plasma cells with eccentric nucleus and perinuclear features (black arrow)
Increased mast cells with densely packed dark purple metachromatic granules (circles, panel A)
Relatively few residual myeloid and erythroid precursors in the field
63745.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with an increase in small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. There is a spectrum of lymphoplasmacytic differentiation, including plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and more abundant basophilic cytoplasm, as well as atypical plasma cells. Mast cells with dense metachromatic granules are increased and scattered among the lymphoid cells (circled, panel A). Normal hematopoietic precursors are relatively decreased. Findings are consistent with involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, with the characteristic accompanying mast cell increase.

ddx.vs: MZL can show plasmacytic differentiation and mast cells, so separation requires clinical distribution and MYD88 L265P (positive in >90% LPL).
CLL cells are uniform small lymphocytes with soccer-ball chromatin, CD5/CD23 positive, without a plasmacytic spectrum.
Myeloma aspirates contain predominantly plasma cells, often with atypia, and lack a clonal small B-lymphocyte component.
SM mast cells are spindled, hypogranular and form aggregates with CD25 expression, rather than scattered round well-granulated mast cells accompanying a lymphoid infiltrate.

63553.recognize_zh: 整個視野滿是各階段的顆粒球前驅細胞，以胞質帶顆粒、核圓或略凹的骨髓球（myelocyte）最多，後骨髓球與帶狀核次之，幾乎看不到芽細胞，呈現「myelocyte peak」的顆粒球增生，典型見於慢性期 CML。
features: Hypercellular smear dominated by granulocytic precursors (increased M:E ratio)
Myelocytes predominate: round to oval eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and pink-lilac granular cytoplasm
Numerous metamyelocytes with kidney-shaped nuclei and band neutrophils
Orderly maturation without increase in blasts or promyelocytes in this field
Erythroid precursors not conspicuous; background with scattered platelets and platelet clumps
63553.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with orderly maturation. Myelocytes form the dominant population, followed by metamyelocytes and band forms, producing a myelocyte peak; blasts are not increased in this field. Erythroid precursors are inconspicuous, and platelets are abundant with small clumps in the background. No obvious dysplasia is seen. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative granulocytic hyperplasia such as chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase, to be confirmed by BCR::ABL1 testing.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrows maintain a mature neutrophil-predominant pyramid with toxic granulation and lack basophilia and dwarf megakaryocytes; BCR::ABL1 is negative.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis (hypogranular, pseudo-Pelger forms) and lacks BCR::ABL1.
CNL is dominated by mature segmented neutrophils with less than 10% immature granulocytes in blood and carries CSF3R mutation rather than BCR::ABL1.

63489.recognize_zh: 左側血片可見染色質濃縮的小淋巴球與破碎細胞（smudge cells）；右側流式圖顯示 CD5+CD19+ 異常 B 細胞（紫色）同時表現 CD23、CD20 偏弱，而在 kappa/lambda 圖上紫色族群分成弱 lambda 與弱 kappa 兩群，這就是雙株（bi-clonal）CLL 的線索。
features: Panel a: small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, plus smudge cells
Panel b: lymphocyte gate on CD45 bright/low SSC
Panel c: distinct CD5+CD19+ aberrant B-cell population (purple) separate from CD5-CD19+ normal B cells (green) and CD5+CD19- T cells (blue)
Panel d: aberrant B cells are CD23 positive with dim CD20 compared with normal B cells
Panel e: aberrant population shows dim light chain expression split into a dim lambda cluster and a dim kappa cluster, whereas normal B cells are brighter and polytypic
63489.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear (a) shows increased small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, with occasional smudge cells. Flow cytometry (b-e) identifies an aberrant B-cell population co-expressing CD19 and CD5, positive for CD23, with dim CD20 and dim surface immunoglobulin light chain expression. On the kappa-versus-lambda plot the aberrant population separates into two dim clusters, one lambda-restricted and one kappa-restricted, distinct from the brighter polytypic normal B cells. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma phenotype with two light chain-restricted clones (bi-clonal CLL), rather than a reactive polyclonal lymphocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive B cells lack CD5 co-expression, have normal-intensity CD20 and light chains, and show a continuous polytypic kappa/lambda distribution rather than discrete dim restricted clusters.
Also CD5+ but typically CD23 negative with bright CD20 and bright light chain, and shows cyclin D1/SOX11 or t(11;14).
Identical phenotype but defined by a clonal B-cell count below 5 x 10^9/L without lymphadenopathy or cytopenias, so absolute count determines the distinction.

ddx.dx: Composite CLL and a second unrelated B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: A second clone with a different phenotype (e.g., CD5-negative, bright CD20, or CD10+) would suggest a distinct lymphoma rather than two CLL-phenotype clones.

63361.recognize_zh: 上方凝膠卡正向定型的 anti-A、anti-B 與對照管都呈混合凝集（MF），反向 A1、B 細胞 3+；下方血片中紅血球聚成不規則團塊並有血小板聚集，這組合提示冷凝集素（cold agglutinin）干擾血型鑑定。
features: Column agglutination (gel) card: anti-A, anti-B and control show mixed-field reactions; anti-D 4+; reverse typing with A1 and B cells 3+
Positive control well indicates an invalid forward type caused by autoagglutination
Peripheral smear with irregular grape-like clusters of agglutinated red cells rather than linear stacks
Several platelet clumps in the smear
Occasional scattered single red cells between agglutinates
63361.describe_en: The composite shows an automated gel ABO/RhD typing card and a peripheral blood smear. Forward typing shows mixed-field reactions with anti-A, anti-B and the control, with 4+ anti-D, and reverse typing shows 3+ reactions with A1 and B cells; the reactive control invalidates the forward type and indicates red cell autoagglutination. The smear shows extensive irregular red cell agglutinates and platelet clumps. Findings are consistent with a potent cold agglutinin causing an ABO typing discrepancy, which is resolved by washing red cells with warm saline and prewarming plasma.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear coin-like stacks in the thin area, disperse with saline replacement and do not make the gel control reactive in the same way as autoagglutination.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes rather than large agglutinates and a DAT positive for IgG, whereas cold agglutinin disease is C3d-positive.

ddx.dx: Mixed-field from recent transfusion or ABO-incompatible transplant
ddx.vs: True chimerism gives mixed-field in specific antisera with a negative control, not in all wells including the control.
EDTA-induced platelet clumping occurs without red cell agglutination or typing discrepancy.

63297.recognize_zh: 中倍血液抹片的單一視野內就有三到四顆帶橘紅色顆粒的分葉核嗜酸性球，另有一顆核形稍不規則的小淋巴球，紅血球正常；顯示明顯嗜酸性球增多但形態成熟，是淋巴球型 HES 抹片常見的樣貌。
features: Increased eosinophils: several mature eosinophils with bilobed/segmented nuclei and orange-red granules in one field
One granulocyte in the center shows paler, lilac granules and a lobulated nucleus (neutrophil versus less granulated eosinophil)
Small lymphocyte with scant pale-blue cytoplasm and a slightly irregular nuclear outline
Red cells normocytic and normochromic; platelets present
No blasts or immature myeloid cells seen
63297.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows a relative increase in eosinophils, with several mature forms in a single field containing bilobed nuclei and abundant orange-red granules. A small lymphocyte with a slightly irregular nuclear contour is also present, and red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. No blasts or dysplastic features are evident. The findings reflect mature eosinophilia; in the setting of an aberrant CD3-CD4+CD7- T-cell population, they are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.dx: Reactive eosinophilia (parasitic infection, allergy, drug reaction)
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, so the discriminator is the absence of a clonal or immunophenotypically aberrant T-cell population and a supporting clinical history.
Morphology overlaps; it is distinguished by FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion/CHIC2 deletion and often elevated serum tryptase with atypical marrow mast cells.
CML shows marked leukocytosis with a left shift and basophilia rather than an isolated increase in mature eosinophils, and is BCR-ABL1 positive.

63233.recognize_zh: 大體照片中是一個卵圓形、表面光滑有包膜的腫塊，包膜上可見血管分布，已做數道切口，旁邊附著脂肪纖維組織；邊界清楚、有包膜的單一腫塊符合單中心型 Castleman 病的大體表現，但切面細節在此圖中看不清楚。
features: Gross photograph of an ovoid, well-circumscribed mass
Smooth, glistening, tan-gray capsule with visible surface blood vessels
Partial serial incisions made into the mass; cut surface is not fully exposed
Attached fibrofatty soft tissue at one pole
No gross evidence of capsular breach or infiltration of adjacent tissue in this view
63233.describe_en: Gross photograph shows an ovoid, well-circumscribed, encapsulated mass with a smooth, tan-gray capsule bearing prominent surface vessels, partially incised by serial cuts, with attached fibrofatty tissue. The cut surface is not adequately displayed to assess color, homogeneity, hemorrhage, necrosis or calcification. No gross invasion of surrounding tissue is evident. A solitary encapsulated mass is compatible with unicentric Castleman disease, although histologic examination is required as many nodal and soft-tissue lesions share this gross appearance.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma involving a single lymph node
ddx.vs: Often shows a homogeneous fish-flesh cut surface and may efface or breach the capsule; distinction requires histology.

ddx.dx: Schwannoma or other encapsulated soft-tissue tumor
ddx.vs: Typically shows a tan-yellow, sometimes cystic cut surface with an associated nerve, and histology reveals spindle cells rather than lymphoid follicles.
Usually lobulated with fibrous septa on cut surface and is composed of epithelial cells with immature T cells on histology.

63169.recognize_zh: 單核球細胞質邊緣有一個小圓形、帶清楚透亮暈圈的酵母菌體，外觀與附近的血小板大小相近但有明確的細胞壁與暈圈，需要仔細篩檢才看得到的念珠菌（Candida）胞內酵母。
features: Monocyte with abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and folded nucleus
Single small round intracytoplasmic yeast form with a central dot and clear refractile halo near the cell margin
Yeast approximately platelet-sized; nearby free platelets appear similar at low magnification
Adjacent neutrophils with fine granulation, without visible organisms
Background red cells with overlapping; no extracellular budding yeasts or pseudohyphae in this field
63169.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monocyte containing a single small round intracytoplasmic yeast form with a well-defined wall and surrounding clear halo. Adjacent neutrophils do not contain visible organisms, and no extracellular budding yeasts or pseudohyphae are identified in this field. The organism is of similar size to nearby platelets, so careful review is needed to avoid overlooking it. Findings are consistent with fungemia with phagocytosed yeast; blood culture identified Candida.

ddx.vs: An overlying platelet has purple granular centre with pale hyalomere and no refractile wall or halo, and lies in a different focal plane.

Histoplasma usually appears as multiple tiny (2-4 um) uniform yeasts packed within monocytes/neutrophils with narrow-based budding, whereas Candida is larger and can form pseudohyphae; culture or antigen testing confirms.
Vacuoles are empty without a central stained body, and Dohle bodies are pale blue irregular patches lacking a defined wall.
Bacteria are much smaller and rod or coccal, while Cryptococcus has a thick capsule producing a wider clear halo and variable size.

63105.recognize_zh: CD21 在病灶部分內襯細胞呈斑駁的膜狀陽性，沿血管腔排列，強度不一；littoral cell angioma 常表現 CD21，這是與一般血管瘤區分的輔助線索。
features: Patchy membranous CD21 staining of cells lining vascular channels
Staining clustered in groups of plump cells rather than diffuse
Many stromal cells and lymphocytes negative
Blood-filled cystic space in lower field with faint background staining
No follicular dendritic cell meshwork pattern
63105.describe_en: CD21 immunostain of the splenic vascular lesion shows patchy membranous staining of plump cells lining the channels, arranged in clusters along vascular spaces, with many surrounding cells negative. A follicular dendritic cell meshwork pattern is not seen. Partial CD21 expression in lining cells is in keeping with the littoral phenotype and supports littoral cell angioma.

ddx.vs: Hemangioma lining cells are CD21-negative and lack histiocytic markers.
FDC sarcoma forms fascicles and whorls of spindle cells with diffuse CD21/CD23/CD35 staining, not channel-lining cells.
Native follicles show a compact FDC meshwork within B-cell areas rather than staining along blood-filled channels.

63041.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒性前驅細胞（前骨髓細胞到骨髓細胞階段）的細胞質正常帶顆粒，但核卻分成二到四個分離的圓形核塊（雙核／多核），且數量很多，提示藥物（醫源性）造成的顆粒球核分裂異常。
features: Granulocytic precursors (promyelocyte/myelocyte stage) with two to four discrete round nuclear lobes or separate nuclei
Cytoplasm retains pink-violet secondary/primary granulation and pale perinuclear zone, indicating otherwise normal cytoplasmic maturation
Nuclear chromatin moderately condensed in each nuclear fragment; no nucleoli evident
Abnormal forms are numerous (panel B shows a cluster), with occasional mature segmented neutrophils and eosinophils
Background red cells unremarkable
63041.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (two panels) shows numerous granulocytic precursors at the promyelocyte-to-myelocyte stage that contain two to four separate, round nuclear lobes while their cytoplasm shows preserved granulation. The abnormal cells occur in clusters, with scattered normal-appearing segmented neutrophils and eosinophils. Blasts are not increased in these fields. In the appropriate clinical setting these findings are suggestive of a drug-induced (iatrogenic) nuclear abnormality of granulopoiesis rather than a primary dysplastic process; correlation with the medication history is essential.

ddx.vs: MDS typically shows hypogranular cytoplasm, pseudo-Pelger nuclei and multilineage dysplasia with clonal cytogenetics, rather than uniformly granulated precursors with multiple round nuclei that resolve after drug withdrawal.
Megaloblastic granulopoiesis shows giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with open chromatin and megaloblastic erythroid precursors, not discrete binucleate myelocytes.
APL cells are atypical promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei, Auer rod bundles and a monotonous population, whereas here cells show orderly maturation to neutrophils.

62913.recognize_zh: 視野中有數個大型母細胞，核染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性，其中央一個細胞的細胞質內可見較粗大的紫色顆粒；在 t(8;21) AML 中，顆粒融合形成的大顆粒稱為假性 Chédiak-Higashi 顆粒（pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules），但此放大倍率下巨大顆粒解析有限。
features: Several large blasts with high to intermediate N:C ratio, round to slightly indented nuclei, and fine chromatin
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm; one central blast shows coarse, enlarged purple cytoplasmic granules
Adjacent granulated cell with pink-lilac granular cytoplasm (maturing myeloid cell)
Scattered small mature lymphocytes
Background of normochromic red cells and scattered platelets
62913.describe_en: Smear shows several large blasts with fine chromatin, occasional nuclear indentation, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, together with scattered small lymphocytes and a maturing granulated myeloid cell. One centrally placed blast contains coarse, enlarged cytoplasmic granules, compatible with the fused granules described as pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules, although truly giant inclusions are not clearly resolved at this magnification. No Auer rods are identified in this field. In the setting of RUNX1::RUNX1T1, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21) showing abnormal granule fusion.

ddx.vs: Giant granules occur in mature neutrophils, lymphocytes, and monocytes of a child with albinism and immunodeficiency, not selectively in leukemic blasts.
Abnormal promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei, heavy azurophilic granules obscuring the nucleus, and bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells).
Dark granules are in mature neutrophils and bands during infection, without an increase in blasts.

62849.recognize_zh: 左右並排的輕鏈免疫染色：kappa 只有零星 3–4 個陽性細胞，lambda 則有大量、成群的胞質陽性漿細胞，lambda 明顯多於 kappa，代表 lambda 輕鏈限制（light chain restriction），證明漿細胞為單株性。
features: Paired immunohistochemistry for kappa (left) and lambda (right) light chains on the same marrow
Kappa: only rare scattered cytoplasm-positive cells
Lambda: numerous cells with strong granular cytoplasmic staining, singly and in small clusters
Lambda-positive cells have round eccentric nuclei and abundant cytoplasm consistent with plasma cells
Lambda-to-kappa ratio visually well above 10:1; background hematopoietic cells negative
62849.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains for kappa and lambda immunoglobulin light chains were performed on the bone marrow trephine. Kappa highlights only rare scattered plasma cells, whereas lambda stains numerous plasma cells distributed singly and in small clusters, with a markedly skewed lambda-to-kappa ratio. The background hematopoietic cells are negative. Findings demonstrate lambda light chain-restricted, monotypic plasma cells, consistent with plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a mixed kappa-predominant pattern with a kappa:lambda ratio of about 2:1, not marked lambda excess.
MGUS also shows light chain restriction but with fewer than 10% clonal plasma cells and no myeloma-defining events, so quantification on CD138 is needed.
These lymphomas can show light chain-restricted plasma cells but also have a CD20-positive clonal B-cell component, which is absent here.

62849.stain: IHC: kappa and lambda light chains

62785.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中細胞被一大片淡紫、呈纖維放射狀的膠狀基質包埋，另一種染色下基質呈淡藍色；骨髓小粒周圍亦充滿此物質，母細胞散在其中，因此稱為「膠狀」白血病（B淋巴母細胞白血病伴隨膠狀基質）。
features: Aspirate with abundant pale purple, fibrillary-to-amorphous extracellular gelatinous matrix radiating around a bubble (A)
Small to medium mononuclear cells with scant cytoplasm embedded within the matrix (A)
Matrix staining pale blue with a second stain, with nuclei appearing pink-red (B, D)
Marrow particles heavily infiltrated and coated by the extracellular material (C, D)
Low resolution limits assessment of blast chromatin detail
62785.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show abundant extracellular, pale purple, fibrillary gelatinous material in which small to medium-sized mononuclear cells with scant cytoplasm are embedded. A second stain highlights the matrix in pale blue. Particles are densely cellular and coated with the same material. Resolution limits detailed evaluation of blast morphology. In the context of B-lymphoblastic leukemia with ETV6-RUNX1, findings illustrate a leukemic marrow with prominent extracellular gelatinous (mucopolysaccharide-rich) matrix.

ddx.dx: Gelatinous transformation (serous fat atrophy) of the marrow
ddx.vs: Serous atrophy occurs in cachexia or anorexia with a hypocellular marrow and fat atrophy rather than blasts embedded in the matrix.
Amyloid is waxy and Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence, not Alcian blue positive hyaluronic acid.

ddx.dx: Smear artifact from clotted or fibrin-rich aspirate
ddx.vs: Fibrin strands are thin and eosinophilic with trapped platelets and do not stain as a diffuse blue mucopolysaccharide ground substance.

62721.recognize_zh: 原始細胞閘門內的核 TdT 對胞質 MPO 流式圖：原始細胞普遍 TdT 弱到中度陽性（約 10³–2×10⁴）；綠色 B 系原始細胞 MPO 低，紅色族群中有一明顯的 MPO 陽性次群（約 3×10⁴–10⁵ 以上），代表同一檢體內同時有 TdT+ 的 B 系與 MPO+ 的骨髓系原始細胞。
features: Gated on blasts; nuclear TdT-FITC (x-axis) versus cytoplasmic MPO-PE (y-axis)
Blasts broadly TdT dim to moderately positive (about 10^3 to 2x10^4)
Green (B-lineage, cCD79a-positive) blasts with low MPO (about 10^3 to 10^4)
Red blast subset with distinctly positive MPO (about 3x10^4 to 5x10^5) and partial TdT expression
Continuous smear between the MPO-low and MPO-positive regions without a sharply separate cluster
62721.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on blasts displays nuclear TdT versus cytoplasmic MPO. Blasts show dim to moderate TdT expression, confirming immaturity. The green, B-lineage-committed blasts have low MPO, whereas a red blast subset shows distinctly positive MPO with partial TdT co-expression. The presence of an MPO-positive blast subset alongside B-lineage blasts fulfills myeloid and B-lineage criteria, and the findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: TdT-positive blasts lack a distinct MPO-positive subset exceeding the level of normal lymphocytes.
TdT can be expressed in AML, but the blasts lack strong CD19 with CD79a, cCD22 or CD10.
Normal promyelocytes and myelocytes are MPO bright with higher side scatter and are TdT negative.

62657.recognize_zh: 左側一群大型腫瘤細胞呈強烈的細胞膜/細胞質 CD3 陽性，與右側散在的小型反應性 T 細胞一樣著色；PEL 雖為 B 細胞來源，卻常失去 B 細胞標記並可異常表現 T 細胞抗原（aberrant CD3）。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with abundant cytoplasm and strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD3 staining
Large vesicular nuclei with nucleoli in the positive cells
Numerous small CD3-positive reactive T cells in the background at right
Small CD3-negative lymphocytes interspersed (presumed B cells)
Staining intensity of tumor cells comparable to background T cells
62657.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry shows a cohesive cluster of large neoplastic cells with abundant cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei displaying strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD3 staining, with numerous small reactive T cells staining in the background. The large-cell staining represents aberrant T-cell antigen expression, which is well described in primary effusion lymphoma, particularly the extracavitary form, despite its B-cell (clonal IG rearrangement) derivation. This pattern is a pitfall that can lead to misclassification as a T-cell lymphoma. Findings are consistent with aberrant CD3 expression in extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma when HHV8 positivity is confirmed.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma / peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: True T-cell lymphomas are HHV8-negative and show TCR rather than immunoglobulin gene rearrangement.
Can show similar large-cell morphology and B-marker loss but is HHV8-negative.
Reactive T cells are small with condensed nuclei, unlike the large vesicular CD3-positive tumor cells here.

62593.recognize_zh: 淋巴結觸片（Romanowsky 染色）：可見許多大型淋巴樣細胞，核圓或有凹陷裂紋、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質少量淡藍色，夾雜較小的中心細胞樣細胞，背景有淋巴腺小體（lymphoglandular bodies）；大型中心母細胞比例高，符合高級別濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Many large lymphoid cells (centroblast-like) with round nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Admixed smaller cells with cleaved, notched or folded nuclei (centrocyte-like)
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm; occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background of lymphoglandular bodies and scattered red blood cells
No tingible body macrophages or mixed inflammatory cells in this field
62593.describe_en: Touch preparation of the lymph node (Romanowsky-type stain) shows a cellular population of atypical lymphoid cells in a background of lymphoglandular bodies and scattered red blood cells. Many cells are large, with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm, admixed with smaller cells bearing cleaved or notched nuclei. Tingible body macrophages, plasma cells and other reactive elements are not evident in this field. The cytology indicates a B-cell lymphoma of follicle-center type with a high proportion of large cells, consistent with high-grade follicular lymphoma in correlation with histology; grading cannot be established on cytology alone.

ddx.vs: DLBCL touch preps look similar cytologically; separation requires tissue architecture showing diffuse rather than follicular growth.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and uniform with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing many lipid vacuoles and numerous tingible body macrophages.
Reactive touch preps show a polymorphous mixture dominated by small lymphocytes with tingible body macrophages, plasma cells and immunoblasts.

62529.recognize_zh: CD138 染色中，散在與小群聚集的漿細胞呈棕色膜狀陽性，主要分布在組織球竇的周邊與髓索；大型組織球與小淋巴球為陰性。Rosai-Dorfman 病常伴隨大量漿細胞，此圖顯示漿細胞增加但無單株性腫瘤的片狀排列。
features: Scattered and loosely clustered cells with strong membranous CD138 positivity (plasma cells)
Plasma cells with eccentric nuclei concentrated around the sinus and in cords
Large histiocytes and small lymphocytes are CD138-negative
No sheets of CD138-positive cells to suggest a plasma cell neoplasm
62529.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD138 highlights increased numbers of plasma cells distributed singly and in small clusters around expanded sinuses and within medullary cords. The large sinus histiocytes and background lymphocytes are negative. There are no confluent sheets of plasma cells. Findings are consistent with the polytypic plasmacytosis that commonly accompanies Rosai-Dorfman disease; kappa/lambda ISH and IgG4 staining can be used to exclude a clonal process or IgG4-related disease.

ddx.vs: IgG4-related disease shows increased IgG4-positive plasma cells (high IgG4:IgG ratio) with S100-negative histiocytes.

ddx.dx: Plasmacytoma / marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells form sheets and are light chain-restricted on kappa/lambda ISH.
Plasma cell Castleman shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells with regressed follicles and lacks S100-positive histiocytes with emperipolesis.

62465.recognize_zh: 抹片薄區仍可見大量紅血球一顆顆重疊排成長鏈狀或堆疊狀（stack of coins），而非不規則團塊，就是 rouleaux；背景稍帶藍灰色，提示血漿蛋白增加，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Red cells stacked in linear and branching chains resembling stacks of coins (rouleaux)
Rouleaux present in an area of the smear where other red cells lie singly, arguing against thick-area artifact
Chains are linear rather than irregular grape-like clumps (not agglutination)
Faint bluish-grey background tint suggestive of increased plasma protein
Two segmented neutrophils and scattered platelets; no circulating plasma cells in this field
62465.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent rouleaux formation, with erythrocytes aligned in linear and branching stacks in a portion of the smear where red cells should otherwise be separate. The aggregates have a regular coin-stack configuration rather than irregular clumps, and the background has a faint bluish tint. Scattered neutrophils and platelets are unremarkable, and no plasma cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with rouleaux formation due to increased plasma immunoglobulin, compatible with the clinical history of multiple myeloma.

ddx.vs: Agglutinates form irregular three-dimensional clumps without linear stacking, often with red cell spherocytes, and persist after saline dilution while rouleaux disperse.
Artifactual overlap is confined to the thick part of the smear, whereas true rouleaux persist in the monolayer area.

ddx.dx: Rouleaux from hyperfibrinogenemia or polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so serum protein electrophoresis and immunofixation distinguish a monoclonal protein from inflammatory causes.

62401.recognize_zh: 高倍下在淡嗜酸性壞死背景中有大量核碎屑（karyorrhectic debris），周圍是細胞質淡染、核呈新月形/C 形的組織球與吞噬碎屑的巨噬細胞，且幾乎看不到嗜中性球；這種「大量凋亡碎屑＋組織球、無嗜中性球」的組合是菊池病（Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease）的特徵。
features: Abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris scattered in a fibrinoid eosinophilic background
Histiocytes with crescentic (C-shaped) eccentric nuclei and pale foamy cytoplasm
Tingible-body macrophages containing phagocytosed apoptotic debris
Admixed larger activated lymphoid cells (immunoblasts/plasmacytoid dendritic cells)
Conspicuous absence of neutrophils
No granulomas identified
62401.describe_en: High-power view of the lymph node shows a necrotizing area with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris set in an eosinophilic fibrinoid background. The debris is surrounded by numerous histiocytes, many with crescentic eccentric nuclei, tingible-body macrophages, and scattered larger activated lymphoid cells. Neutrophils and eosinophils are notably absent, and no granulomas are seen. The findings are consistent with histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease), pending exclusion of lupus lymphadenitis and infection.

ddx.vs: Lupus lymphadenitis looks nearly identical but may show hematoxylin bodies, plasma cells and Azzopardi phenomenon, with serologic confirmation.
Bacterial, cat-scratch or herpes lymphadenitis contains neutrophils, microabscesses or granulomas, which are absent in Kikuchi disease.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell or diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows sheets of cytologically atypical cells with clonal immunophenotype, whereas Kikuchi histiocytes are MPO+/CD68+ and CD8+ T cells are reactive.

62337.recognize_zh: 胸椎矢狀面 STIR 影像：脂肪訊號被抑制後，後方棘突與部分椎體出現斑片狀高訊號（骨髓水腫/腫瘤活動區），與周圍較暗的正常骨髓對比明顯，符合骨髓瘤侵犯。
features: Sagittal STIR (fat-suppressed fluid-sensitive) MRI of the thoracic spine
Patchy hyperintense signal within multiple spinous processes and posterior elements
Heterogeneous, mildly hyperintense foci within several vertebral bodies
Spinal cord and CSF well visualized without obvious intrinsic cord signal abnormality on this slice
Vertebral body heights largely preserved on this slice
62337.describe_en: Sagittal STIR MRI of the thoracic spine demonstrates patchy hyperintense signal within multiple spinous processes and posterior elements, together with heterogeneous foci of increased signal in several vertebral bodies, reflecting marrow edema and active marrow infiltration. The spinal cord is visualized without obvious intrinsic signal change on this slice. When correlated with diffuse T1 hypointensity on companion images, the findings are consistent with multifocal myelomatous involvement of the spine.

ddx.vs: Metastases produce similar STIR-bright lesions, and separation relies on clinical history, M-protein studies and tissue biopsy rather than signal characteristics.
Benign fractures show band-like edema parallel to the endplate with preserved posterior elements, whereas this case shows multifocal posterior element and spinous process involvement.
Infection centers on the intervertebral disc with disc hyperintensity and endplate erosion across adjacent vertebrae, not on spinous processes with spared discs.

62273.recognize_zh: CD10 染色中，大結節內的生發中心 B 細胞呈零碎、不規則的棕色斑塊散布，未形成完整圓形的生發中心；右上方一個小而完整的 CD10 陽性濾泡作為正常對照，顯示 PTGC 中生發中心被打散。
features: CD10-positive germinal center B cells arranged in fragmented, irregular clusters and strands within the large nodule
No intact round germinal center within the nodule; positive cells are dispersed among CD10-negative mantle cells
Compact, round CD10-positive germinal center in a small normal follicle at the upper right (internal control)
Interfollicular areas negative except for scattered positive cells
No CD10-positive cells in the interfollicular region forming sheets
62273.describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemistry highlights germinal center B cells that are broken into irregular, fragmented clusters and strands dispersed throughout the enlarged nodule, without a cohesive round germinal center. A small neighboring follicle contains a compact, intact CD10-positive germinal center for comparison, and the interfollicular areas are largely negative. This fragmentation of the germinal center by infiltrating CD10-negative mantle cells is consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows well-formed, crowded CD10-positive follicles that co-express BCL2, often with CD10-positive cells spilling into interfollicular areas, rather than fragmented CD10 clusters within a mantle-cell-rich nodule.
NLPHL nodules typically lack residual CD10-positive germinal center meshworks and contain CD10-negative LP cells, although residual germinal centers can be seen at the edge of nodules.

62209.recognize_zh: 兩張流式點圖（panel C）：左圖 CD23 對 FMC7，64.3% 細胞為 CD23+/FMC7−；右圖 CD19 對 CD5，74.8% 細胞落在 CD19+/CD5+ 象限，顯示 CD5 異常共表現的 B 細胞群，符合 CLL 表型。
features: Left dot plot (CD23 PE vs FMC-7 FITC): 64.30% in upper-left quadrant (CD23+/FMC7-), 3.44% CD23+/FMC7+, 0.76% FMC7+ only
Right dot plot (CD19 PE vs CD5 FITC): discrete cluster of 74.80% in upper-right quadrant (CD19+/CD5+)
Minor CD19+/CD5- population (20.18%) and small CD5+/CD19- T-cell population (3.24%)
Tight, homogeneous B-cell cluster with CD5 expression at a level comparable to or slightly below the T cells
Quadrant gates on gated population P1
62209.describe_en: This figure shows two flow cytometry dot plots gated on the lymphoid population rather than a morphologic image. The CD19 versus CD5 plot shows a dominant homogeneous population of CD19-positive B cells co-expressing CD5 (74.8%), separate from a small CD5-positive, CD19-negative T-cell population (3.2%). The CD23 versus FMC7 plot shows that most cells are CD23-positive and FMC7-negative (64.3%). This CD5+/CD23+/FMC7-negative B-cell phenotype is consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; demonstration of light-chain restriction would confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma would populate the CD19+/CD5+ quadrant but typically falls in the FMC7-positive, CD23-negative region, with cyclin D1 confirming the diagnosis.
Rare CD5-positive marginal zone lymphomas are usually CD23-negative and FMC7-positive with bright CD20/surface Ig, and lack a typical CLL score.

62081.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片紅血球明顯小球性低色素，大小形狀不一，可見大量標靶細胞（target cells）、淚滴狀與碎片狀紅血球，並有一顆有核紅血球（NRBC），整體符合 β 型重度地中海貧血的血片表現。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with predominantly microcytic, hypochromic red cells
Numerous target cells and scattered teardrop cells, fragmented cells and irregular poikilocytes
A nucleated red blood cell with dense pyknotic nucleus (center right)
Occasional larger, paler red cells; no obvious basophilic stippling resolved at this magnification
One leukocyte present; platelets appear adequate in this field
62081.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with a predominance of microcytic, hypochromic red cells. There are numerous target cells, together with teardrop cells, fragmented forms, and irregular poikilocytes, and a circulating nucleated red blood cell is present. Occasional larger pale cells are seen; fine inclusions such as basophilic stippling cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with severe beta-thalassemia (beta-thalassemia major) in the appropriate clinical and hemoglobin analysis context.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows microcytic hypochromic cells and pencil cells but far fewer target cells and rarely circulating nucleated red cells, with low ferritin.
HbH disease can look similar on smear but shows golf-ball inclusions on supravital brilliant cresyl blue staining and an HbH fast band on HPLC/electrophoresis.
Morphology overlaps, so distinction requires HPLC showing a large HbE fraction in the A2 window along with HbF.
Shows a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts in marrow rather than a globin chain imbalance on HPLC.

62017.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD34 染色中，陽性的主要是細長的血管內皮，造血細胞中幾乎沒有陽性母細胞；另見一顆巨核細胞呈細胞質顆粒狀 CD34 陽性，巨核細胞表現 CD34 可見於 MDS 等骨髓發育不良狀態。
features: Cellular marrow with numerous CD34-negative hematopoietic cells
CD34 highlights endothelial cells of small vessels and capillaries (internal control)
No increased or clustered CD34-positive blasts
A megakaryocyte with granular cytoplasmic CD34 staining (right center)
Other megakaryocytes negative or faintly stained
62017.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow in which CD34 highlights capillary endothelium, while hematopoietic precursors are essentially negative with no increase or clustering of CD34-positive blasts. A megakaryocyte shows granular cytoplasmic CD34 expression. The absence of increased blasts supports a lower-risk myelodysplastic neoplasm, and aberrant CD34 expression in megakaryocytes may be seen in myelodysplastic neoplasms, consistent with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia in this case.

ddx.vs: MDS-EB shows increased CD34-positive blasts often in clusters, not seen here.
MPNs show clustered large, atypical megakaryocytes on H&E; CD34 megakaryocyte staining is not specific and must be interpreted with morphology.
Reactive megakaryocytes are usually CD34 negative, and there is no morphologic dysplasia or ring sideroblasts.

61953.recognize_zh: 低倍下左側為密集的淋巴組織，右側則是淡粉紅、細胞較稀疏的纖維化／水腫區，內含散在細胞；此倍率看不清腫瘤細胞形態，只能看出淋巴結結構被破壞並有硬化帶，需高倍與CD30確認ALCL。
features: Low-power field with a dense lymphoid area on the left and a pale eosinophilic, hypocellular fibrotic/edematous zone on the right
Scattered individual cells within the pale stromal zone; cytologic detail not resolvable at this magnification
Irregular interface between the cellular and sclerotic areas, indicating architectural disruption
No well-formed germinal centers identifiable in the field
61953.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows a dense lymphoid area abutting a pale, hypocellular fibrotic to edematous zone containing scattered cells, with loss of recognizable follicular architecture in the field. Cytologic detail of the large cells is not resolvable at this magnification. The low-power appearance is nonspecific; in this case the diagnosis of ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma rests on the high-power hallmark cells and uniform strong CD30 expression.

ddx.vs: NSCHL shows broad collagen bands encircling nodules with lacunar cells that are CD15+ and weak PAX5+, whereas ALCL cells are PAX5-negative with sheets of CD30+ hallmark cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymph node with capsular/hilar fibrosis
ddx.vs: Reactive fibrosis contains no atypical large cells and preserves follicles, which requires high-power and CD30 review to exclude.
Carcinoma forms cohesive keratin-positive nests within desmoplastic stroma, whereas ALCL cells are keratin-negative and CD30-positive.

61889.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中同時出現一個細胞質深藍、核染色質細緻的大型原始細胞（標1），以及多個後髓細胞、帶狀核與髓細胞（標2–5），呈現完整的顆粒球成熟階段「左移」，背景血小板偏多，符合慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）的血液表現。
features: Left-shifted granulocytic series in peripheral blood: myelocytes, metamyelocytes with kidney-shaped nuclei, and band neutrophils (labeled 2-5)
One large blast-like cell (labeled 1) with high N:C ratio, round nucleus, fine chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Myelocytes (labeled 5) with round-to-oval eccentric nuclei and pale granular cytoplasm
No dysplastic features evident in the maturing granulocytes (normal granulation, no pseudo-Pelger forms)
Numerous small platelets scattered in the background; red cells show mild poikilocytosis
61889.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukoerythroblastic-appearing but orderly left-shifted granulocytic population, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms, without appreciable dysplasia. A single large immature cell with a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm is present; its lineage (myeloblast versus basophilic/pro-normoblast) cannot be assigned with certainty on morphology alone. Platelets appear increased in number. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in chronic phase, pending confirmation of BCR::ABL1 and blast enumeration on a full differential.

ddx.vs: A reactive neutrophilia shows predominantly segmented and band forms with toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, few myelocytes, and no basophilia or thrombocytosis, and is BCR::ABL1-negative.
Atypical CML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia (hypogranulation, abnormal nuclear segmentation) and lacks BCR::ABL1, whereas the maturing cells here appear non-dysplastic.

ddx.dx: Leukoerythroblastosis from marrow infiltration or fibrosis
ddx.vs: Leukoerythroblastic smears pair immature granulocytes with nucleated red cells and teardrop cells in a usually normal or low total WBC, unlike the marked myelocyte-rich leukocytosis of CML.

ddx.dx: CML in accelerated or blast phase
ddx.vs: Progression is defined by increased blasts (and basophils) on a full differential; a single blast in one field does not establish it.

61825.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央有一顆巨核細胞，核分成多個彼此分離的圓形小核（separated nuclear lobes），另見小型低分葉巨核細胞，背景為高細胞性並夾雜紅血球前驅細胞與含鐵血黃素，提示巨核細胞發育不良（MDS 相關）。
features: Megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated, round nuclei (dysplastic multinucleation)
Additional small megakaryocytes with hypolobated nuclei
Hypercellular marrow with numerous erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors and mature neutrophils
Coarse brown hemosiderin deposits; adipocytes at lower left
61825.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and a prominent erythroid component. Megakaryocytes are dysplastic, including a large form with multiple widely separated round nuclei and smaller hypolobated forms. Brown hemosiderin deposits are present, and a blast population is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasm in a patient with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes are normally lobulated with connected nuclear lobes rather than separated discrete nuclei.
MPN megakaryocytes are large hyperlobated or bulbous forms in clusters, not multinucleated with separated round nuclei.
Megaloblastic change shows open chromatin in erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes, and resolves with B12/folate replacement.

61761.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中一個略大於小淋巴球的淋巴樣細胞，核圓帶輕微不規則、染色質細緻偏顆粒狀、核質比高，細胞質少量深藍並有細小突起；單一細胞形態不具特異性，需配合流式 CD5+/CD23- 與 cyclin D1 才能判定為被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Single atypical lymphoid cell, slightly larger than a small lymphocyte (about 1.5 red cell diameters)
High N:C ratio with round, slightly irregular nuclear outline
Finely granular to dispersed chromatin without a conspicuous nucleolus in this focus
Scant deep blue cytoplasm with small irregular surface projections
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and a few crenated cells; one red cell contains a small dark inclusion (Howell-Jolly body-like or overlying platelet)
61761.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single atypical lymphoid cell slightly larger than a mature small lymphocyte, with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a round to slightly irregular nucleus with finely granular, relatively dispersed chromatin and a thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small projections. No smudge cells are present in this field, and the red cells show only mild nonspecific changes with one small red cell inclusion. The cell is atypical but morphologically nonspecific. In the context of the stated diagnosis, it is consistent with circulating blastoid mantle cell lymphoma cells, which should be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23-, CD200 dim/negative) and cyclin D1/CCND1 studies.

ddx.vs: Cells are small with coarse 'soccer-ball' block-like chromatin and accompanied by smudge cells, and are CD23+ CD200+ LEF1+ rather than CD23- cyclin D1+.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic or large granular reactive lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus with moderately condensed chromatin and more cytoplasm.
Blasts show very fine homogeneous chromatin with TdT and CD34 positivity rather than a mature B-cell CD5+ cyclin D1+ phenotype.
Cells have abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and oval/bean-shaped nuclei, and are CD103/CD25/CD11c positive.

61697.recognize_zh: 100 倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間的造血組織內，黃圈標示多群增多的大型巨核細胞，細胞密度大致正常至輕度增加、仍保有脂肪空泡；低倍下巨核細胞數量增加並鬆散聚集，是本態性血小板增多症的線索。
features: Low-power view of bony trabeculae with intertrabecular hematopoietic marrow
Increased megakaryocytes forming loose clusters (circled in yellow)
Megakaryocytes are large with abundant cytoplasm
Normocellular to mildly hypercellular marrow with preserved fat spaces
Normal-appearing trabecular bone without osteosclerosis
61697.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows normocellular to mildly hypercellular intertrabecular marrow with preserved fat spaces and increased large megakaryocytes arranged in loose clusters. Bony trabeculae appear unremarkable without osteosclerosis. Detailed megakaryocyte nuclear morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification, and fibrosis requires reticulin staining. The increase in loosely clustered large megakaryocytes without marked hypercellularity is consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Pre-PMF shows a clearly hypercellular marrow with granulocytic proliferation and tight clusters of atypical hyperchromatic megakaryocytes.
PV shows age-adjusted hypercellularity with trilineage (panmyelotic) proliferation and erythrocytosis.
CML shows markedly hypercellular marrow with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1 fusion.

61633.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中只見少數散在的有核細胞，其中幾顆深染、偏大的單核細胞可能為循環中的淋巴瘤細胞；此放大倍率無法確認細胞細節，需結合臨床與組織切片中血管內大型 B 細胞的證據。
features: Low-power peripheral blood smear with adequate red cell monolayer
Only a few scattered nucleated cells, suggesting leukopenia
Several darkly staining mononuclear cells, some slightly larger than a small lymphocyte
Cytologic detail (chromatin, nucleoli) not resolvable at this magnification
Occasional red cell clumps and few platelets; no obvious schistocytes
61633.describe_en: Low-power view of a Wright-stained peripheral blood smear shows a paucicellular field with only a few scattered nucleated cells, several of which are mononuclear cells with dark nuclei. Red cells are largely unremarkable at this magnification, and platelets appear sparse. Nuclear and cytoplasmic detail cannot be assessed at this power, so circulating large atypical lymphoid cells cannot be confirmed or excluded from this image alone. Correlation with high-power examination, flow cytometry and tissue biopsy (e.g., random skin or marrow) is required; findings are compatible with, but not diagnostic of, peripheral blood involvement by intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology of circulating cells can be identical; IVLBCL is defined by the intravascular growth pattern in tissue without a mass lesion.
Reactive lymphocytes are polyclonal with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells, whereas lymphoma cells are monotonous with high N:C ratio and show light-chain restriction by flow.
Can present with cytopenias and fever in Asian-variant IVLBCL, but lacks a clonal large B-cell population on biopsy.

61569.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現多顆中大型母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻均勻、核仁不明顯，細胞質極少且淡藍無顆粒，部分核有凹痕；缺乏顆粒與 Auer 小體，符合循環中的淋巴母細胞（B-ALL）。
features: Multiple circulating blasts, medium to large (about 1.5-2 times a red cell)
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale-to-moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to irregular nuclei, some with indentations or angular contours
Finely dispersed, homogeneous chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Smudge cell at the bottom of the field; red cells largely normocytic
61569.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows multiple circulating medium-to-large blasts. The blasts have very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to irregular nuclei with occasional indentations, finely dispersed homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are absent, and a smudge cell is present. Findings are consistent with circulating lymphoblasts; flow cytometry is required to confirm B-lymphoblastic leukemia and exclude myeloid lineage.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Agranular myeloblasts can look identical; MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117 positivity and absence of CD19/cCD79a distinguish them.
Reactive cells have mature condensed chromatin and more cytoplasm, without blastic fine chromatin.

ddx.dx: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant
ddx.vs: CD5+/cyclin D1+ mature B cells with surface light chain and no TdT/CD34.
Morphologically identical; cytoplasmic CD3 positivity on flow.

61505.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球邊緣出現缺口或半月形的透明空泡，血紅素被推擠到細胞一側（咬痕細胞 bite cell／水泡細胞 blister cell），而細胞外形大致仍保持圓形；在使用 rasburicase 後溶血的病人，這是 G6PD 缺乏引起氧化性溶血的線索。
features: Numerous red cells with peripheral semicircular bites or crescent-shaped membrane-bound clear blisters
Hemoglobin retracted toward one side of affected cells (eccentrocyte-like appearance)
Many red cells lack central pallor, suggestive of spherocytic change
Background normocytic red cells with mild anisocytosis
Rare platelets; no schistocytes, parasites, or leukocytes in this field
61505.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells with peripheral membrane defects, including semicircular bite-like notches and crescent-shaped clear blisters with hemoglobin condensed toward the opposite side. Several red cells appear dense with reduced central pallor. Schistocytes and red cell parasites are not identified. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis with bite and blister cells, as seen in G6PD deficiency exposed to an oxidant such as rasburicase; a Heinz body preparation and G6PD assay (ideally after recovery of reticulocytes) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Schistocytes are small angular fragments with pointed ends, whereas bite cells preserve most of a rounded contour with a smooth notch.
Spherocytes lack central pallor but have no bites or blisters, and the osmotic fragility or EMA binding test is abnormal.
Unstable hemoglobins also form Heinz bodies and bite cells, so separation requires G6PD enzyme assay and hemoglobin stability testing.
Artifactual refractile vacuoles occur in thick areas and vary with focus, rather than showing consistent peripheral hemoglobin displacement.

61441.recognize_zh: 免疫染色中僅中央一顆較大的細胞呈強烈棕色核染色（並延伸至胞質），周圍細胞皆為藍色陰性，對應微小病毒 B19 核內包涵體所在的前紅血球母細胞，確認感染。
features: Single enlarged cell with strong, dark brown nuclear staining for parvovirus B19 antigen, with some cytoplasmic spillover
Positive cell size compatible with a pronormoblast
Surrounding hematopoietic and stromal cells negative, with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Clean background without nonspecific staining
61441.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for parvovirus B19 on marrow tissue shows a single enlarged cell with strong nuclear and partial cytoplasmic positivity, corresponding in size to an erythroid precursor harboring viral inclusion. Surrounding cells are negative, and background staining is minimal. Findings confirm parvovirus B19 infection of erythroid precursors, supporting the H&E impression of viral inclusion-bearing pronormoblasts. Correlation with serum parvovirus PCR and reticulocyte count is recommended.

ddx.vs: Artifactual staining is weak, diffuse, and not confined to the nucleus of a single enlarged cell.
CMV is confirmed with a CMV-specific antibody and affects endothelial/stromal cells with owl-eye inclusions.
Hemosiderin is granular golden-brown in macrophage cytoplasm and is present on the unstained control, unlike crisp nuclear chromogen.

61377.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑明顯增厚、形狀不規則並互相吻合連結，骨量增加使髓腔縮小，髓腔內可見紡錘狀細胞與膠原呈流水狀排列的纖維化，符合骨硬化（osteosclerosis）。
