features: Markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying a large proportion of the core
Trabeculae with irregular contours and bulbous projections, with reduced intertrabecular marrow space
Intertrabecular marrow fibrosis with streaming spindle cells and collagen deposition
Patchy residual hematopoiesis and scattered adipocytes
Dilated sinusoids/vascular spaces within fibrotic areas
61377.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bone trabeculae with a corresponding reduction in marrow space. The intertrabecular areas show fibrosis with streaming spindle cells and collagen, patchy residual hematopoiesis and dilated vascular spaces. Findings are consistent with osteosclerosis with marrow fibrosis, as seen in advanced myeloproliferative neoplasms such as primary myelofibrosis; reticulin and trichrome stains, megakaryocyte assessment and correlation with driver mutation studies (JAK2, CALR, MPL) are recommended.

ddx.vs: New bone formation is accompanied by clusters of cohesive cytokeratin-positive tumor cells within the desmoplastic stroma.
Shows peritrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclasts and dissecting resorption along trabeculae rather than diffuse myeloproliferative changes.
Trabeculae show a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines with prominent osteoclasts and osteoblasts, with preserved hematopoietic marrow.
Sclerotic trabeculae are associated with lambda-restricted plasma cells and lymphoid aggregates rimmed by plasma cells.

61249.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一大片細胞彼此黏聚成融合狀（syncytial）的團塊，細胞核大而圓、核仁清楚、細胞質豐富且邊界不清，外觀與周圍造血細胞完全不同，符合轉移性癌細胞。
features: Large cohesive syncytial sheet of cells with indistinct cell borders
Large round to oval nuclei, several times the size of adjacent lymphocytes, with mild anisonucleosis
Finely granular to vesicular chromatin with small but distinct nucleoli
Abundant pale basophilic to lavender cytoplasm
Overlapping, crowded nuclei in thicker areas of the cluster; scattered hematopoietic cells at the periphery
61249.describe_en: Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive cluster of non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct cell borders forming a syncytial aggregate. The cells have large round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin, small distinct nucleoli and abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm, and they are several times larger than the scattered background hematopoietic cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow; given the history, breast primary is favored, and confirmation by core biopsy with immunohistochemistry (e.g., cytokeratin, GATA3) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are solitary cells with a single multilobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, not clusters of multiple separate round nuclei.
Osteoclasts are single giant cells with multiple uniform, well-separated nuclei inside one sharply defined cell with granular cytoplasm, without nuclear atypia.
Hematolymphoid neoplasms are dyscohesive single cells, whereas this aggregate shows true cohesion; cytokeratin versus CD45 immunostaining resolves difficult cases.

61185.recognize_zh: 周邊血紅血球大小與血色大致正常，散佈數個表面有棘狀突起的刺狀紅血球，另見一個小淋巴球；標題所述的標靶細胞在此視野中不易明確辨認，形態本身並不特異，需搭配 HPLC 判讀血紅素變異。
features: Red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic with normal density on the film
Scattered spiculated red cells; most have fairly regular short projections resembling echinocytes, a few with irregular spicules (acanthocyte-like)
Target cells are not convincingly identified in this field
One small mature lymphocyte; platelets are adequate and of normal size
No microcytosis, hypochromia, basophilic stippling or nucleated red cells evident
61185.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells of normal density that are largely normocytic and normochromic. Scattered spiculated red cells are present, most with regular short projections more in keeping with echinocytes, and a few with irregular spicules resembling acanthocytes; target cells are not convincingly seen in this field. A small lymphocyte and adequate platelets are present. The morphology is nonspecific and does not by itself indicate a hemoglobinopathy; correlation with the HPLC finding of a large peak in the HbA2 window is required.

ddx.dx: In vitro crenation (storage or drying artifact)
ddx.vs: Artifactual echinocytes are evenly distributed with regular spicules and disappear on a fresh smear, unlike true acanthocytes with irregular spicules.
Beta-thalassemia trait shows microcytosis, hypochromia, target cells and stippling with HbA2 only 3.5-8%, not normocytic cells with a >40% peak.
HbE trait has near-normal morphology with mild microcytosis and target cells, and its variant co-elutes in the HbA2 window on HPLC.

ddx.dx: Acanthocytosis from liver disease or abetalipoproteinemia
ddx.vs: These produce numerous dense acanthocytes with irregular spicules rather than occasional crenated cells.

61121.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下為混合性浸潤：小淋巴球、漿細胞樣細胞、具淡粉紅色細胞質的上皮樣組織球、散在嗜酸性球，右側可見多核巨細胞與層狀粉紅色角蛋白碎屑，呈肉芽腫樣反應，屬邊緣區淋巴瘤背景中的伴隨變化。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular dense nuclei
Plasmacytoid cells and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei admixed
Epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei
Multinucleated giant cells, one adjacent to laminated eosinophilic keratinous material (foreign-body type reaction)
Scattered eosinophils with bright red granules; occasional mitotic figure
61121.describe_en: At high power the dermal infiltrate is polymorphous, composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells, admixed with epithelioid histiocytes, scattered eosinophils and multinucleated giant cells. One giant cell lies adjacent to laminated eosinophilic keratinous debris, suggesting a foreign-body reaction to ruptured adnexal keratin. No sheets of large transformed cells are identified in this field. These reactive components can be seen in extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the skin and should not distract from the clonal plasmacytic B-cell population demonstrated by ancillary studies.

ddx.dx: Ruptured follicular cyst or folliculitis with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: A purely reactive process lacks the light-chain-restricted B-cell/plasmacytic population and the destructive diffuse lymphoid infiltrate seen elsewhere in the lesion.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in the mixed background, which are not identified here.
LCH shows sheets of grooved-nucleus CD1a/langerin-positive cells with eosinophils rather than epithelioid histiocytes with keratin-associated giant cells.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma with granulomatous features
ddx.vs: Granulomatous MF shows atypical cerebriform T cells and epidermotropism with a monoclonal TCR rearrangement.

61057.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆嗜中性球核分成約 7 葉（分葉過多，hypersegmentation），周圍紅血球大小不一並有許多大卵圓形紅血球（macro-ovalocytes），加上淚滴狀紅血球，是巨母細胞性貧血的典型周邊血表現。
features: Neutrophil with about 7 nuclear lobes (hypersegmentation; >=6 lobes is diagnostic, >5% with 5 lobes suggestive)
Marked anisocytosis with numerous oval macrocytes (macro-ovalocytes)
Poikilocytosis including teardrop cells
Some red cells contain small dark inclusions, possibly Howell-Jolly bodies or basophilic material
Platelets small and clumped; photograph has a yellow-green color cast limiting color assessment
61057.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with prominent oval macrocytes and occasional teardrop cells. A neutrophil with approximately seven nuclear lobes is present. Several red cells contain small dark inclusions consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies, although the color cast of the photograph limits characterization. Platelets are present in small clumps. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia (vitamin B12 or folate deficiency).

ddx.vs: MDS more often shows hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger) and hypogranular neutrophils, and macrocytes are usually round rather than oval, with normal B12/folate levels.
Morphology can be identical; medication history and normal vitamin levels distinguish it.
These produce round macrocytes and target cells without hypersegmented neutrophils.

60993.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 淋巴組織內可見許多大小不一的淡染濾泡樣結構；免疫染色（抗體未標示）濾泡周邊帶與濾泡間區陽性、濾泡中心大多陰性，只剩散在陽性細胞（箭頭）。影像本身只顯示非特異性的淋巴組織結構改變，無法單憑型態確認 CARD11（CARMA1）相關免疫缺陷，需結合基因檢測。
features: Low power H&E: lymphoid tissue with numerous pale, round follicle-like nodules of varying size distributed throughout
Interfollicular areas densely cellular with focal eosinophilic/congested zones
Immunostain (panel B, antibody not labeled): strong staining of mantle/marginal rims and interfollicular regions
Nodule centers largely negative, containing only scattered positive cells (arrows)
No cytologic detail available at this magnification
60993.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymphoid tissue shows numerous pale follicle-like nodules of variable size within a densely cellular background. An immunostain (antibody not specified) highlights the rims surrounding the nodules and the interfollicular areas, whereas the nodule centers are largely negative with only scattered positive cells (arrows). The architecture is altered but the findings are nonspecific at this magnification, and a CARD11/CARMA1-related immunodeficiency cannot be diagnosed on morphology alone; correlation with lineage-specific immunostains, flow cytometry of lymphocyte subsets and genetic testing is required. The image is only partially informative for the stated entity.

ddx.vs: Shows polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and intact mantles, and lacks a genetic immunodeficiency; ancillary lymphocyte-subset and genetic studies are needed to separate.
Back-to-back monotonous follicles without polarization, BCL2-positive germinal centers and IGH::BCL2, rather than reactive-appearing nodules.
Characterized by paracortical expansion of CD3+ TCRab+ CD4-/CD8- double-negative T cells with FAS pathway defects.
Features regressed, hyalinized germinal centers penetrated by vessels with onion-skin mantle zones.

60865.recognize_zh: Ki-67 染色在真皮淋巴浸潤中呈斑駁分布：數個邊界不清的高增生群聚（被腫瘤殘食的反應性濾泡中心），周圍則為低增生的小淋巴細胞；不可把這些熱點誤判為大 B 細胞轉化。
features: Heterogeneous, mottled Ki-67 nuclear staining within a dermal lymphoid infiltrate
Several discrete clusters of densely Ki-67-positive nuclei corresponding to colonized/overrun germinal centers
Low proliferation index in the surrounding interfollicular small lymphoid cells
Dermal collagen with sparse positive cells at left
60865.describe_en: Ki-67 immunostain of the dermal lymphoid infiltrate shows a mottled pattern of proliferation. Discrete clusters of densely positive nuclei correspond to reactive follicular structures that are overrun by the neoplastic B-cell infiltrate, while the surrounding interfollicular population shows a low proliferation index. The high-proliferation foci follow a follicular distribution and should not be interpreted as large B-cell transformation in the absence of sheets of large cells on H&E. Findings are consistent with the proliferation pattern of primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / large cell transformation
ddx.vs: Transformation shows diffuse sheets of large cells with a uniformly high Ki-67 index, rather than discrete follicle-shaped hot spots in a low-proliferation background.
PCFCL follicles lack polarization and often have a relatively low Ki-67 index in neoplastic follicles, whereas colonized reactive germinal centers here remain highly proliferative.
Reactive germinal centers are also Ki-67 high but are well formed with polarized zonation and surrounded by polytypic B cells without light-chain restriction.

60801.recognize_zh: 上方淋巴細胞核略有凹陷、胞質量比典型 CLL 細胞多且淡藍；下方細胞核圓、染色質塊狀、胞質稀少，較接近典型 CLL 細胞。同一抹片中混有核形不規則與胞質較多的細胞，是 12 號染色體三體 CLL 非典型型態的線索。
features: Two small mature-appearing lymphocytes
Upper cell: slightly indented nucleus with moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Lower cell: round nucleus with clumped (soccer-ball-like) chromatin and scant cytoplasm
No visible nucleoli in either cell
Unremarkable background red cells
60801.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small lymphocytes. One has a round nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, typical of CLL cells, whereas the other shows a slightly indented nuclear contour with a more generous rim of pale blue cytoplasm. Nucleoli are not evident. In the context of a CLL immunophenotype, this admixture of typical and cleaved, more cytoplasmic cells is compatible with CLL with atypical morphology, as seen with trisomy 12.

ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap, but cells are CD23-negative/dim with cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity and t(11;14).
Morphologically identical to CLL cells; separated only by a clonal B-cell count below 5 x 10^9/L without tissue involvement.
Look the same individually; a clonal CD5+/CD23+ population with light-chain restriction on flow cytometry is required.

60609.recognize_zh: 抹片中的淋巴樣細胞核為圓形至卵圓、染色質均勻，胞質豐富淡藍灰色，但邊緣平滑、幾乎看不到典型的毛狀突起（hairless）；骨髓切片呈瀰漫性浸潤、細胞間距均勻（fried-egg 樣），免疫染色呈膜陽性，仍需以免疫表型確認為毛細胞白血病。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval, slightly eccentric nuclei and homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with smooth or broad, flat borders and few or no fine hair-like projections in panel A
Other smear (B) shows cells with fuzzy, irregular cytoplasmic margins
Bone marrow biopsy: diffuse, monotonous interstitial infiltrate with evenly spaced nuclei and clear cytoplasmic halos
Immunohistochemistry: strong membranous staining of virtually all infiltrating cells
60609.describe_en: Smears show medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm; in one preparation the cytoplasmic borders are smooth and largely lack the fine hair-like projections classically expected, while another shows irregular fuzzy margins. The bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate with evenly spaced nuclei and clear cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry shows diffuse membranous staining of the neoplastic cells. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia with inconspicuous hairy projections, and diagnosis should rely on flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123), annexin A1 and BRAF V600E testing.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent nucleolus, are CD25-negative, annexin A1-negative and BRAF V600E wild type, and usually present with leukocytosis.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar short villi, a nodular/intrasinusoidal marrow pattern and lack CD103/CD25/annexin A1 coexpression.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and fine azurophilic granules and express CD14/CD64 rather than B-cell markers.
Mast cells show granular cytoplasm and spindling with tryptase and CD117 positivity, whereas hairy cells are CD20-positive B cells.

60673.recognize_zh: 乳房組織中一側為深染淋巴球浸潤，另一側為大片淡嗜酸性細胞（箭頭）；高倍下這些組織球的細胞質被嗜酸性、纖維狀／針狀結晶填滿，把細胞拉成梭形而核小且偏位，屬結晶儲積組織球增生症，提示伴隨單株免疫球蛋白分泌的淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A (low power): breast adipose tissue with a dense basophilic lymphoid infiltrate (upper right) merging into sheets of pale eosinophilic cells (arrows)
Panel B (high power): sheets of large histiocytes with abundant densely eosinophilic cytoplasm filled with elongated, needle-like/fibrillary crystalline inclusions
Histiocyte nuclei small, oval, bland and often displaced; cells appear spindled due to crystal packing
Scattered small lymphocytes and plasma cell-like cells between histiocytes
No mammary epithelial carcinoma is seen in these fields
60673.describe_en: Section of breast tissue shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate adjacent to sheets of large pale eosinophilic cells infiltrating adipose tissue. At high power these cells are histiocytes whose abundant cytoplasm is distended by eosinophilic, needle-like and fibrillary crystalline inclusions, with small bland displaced nuclei, admixed with small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells. The crystals typically represent intralysosomal monoclonal immunoglobulin (usually kappa). Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis associated with a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation (extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT type); CD68/CD163, light chain studies and B-cell markers are recommended.

ddx.vs: Granular cell tumor cells have coarse granular (not crystalline) cytoplasm and are S100/SOX10 positive and CD68 positive but not associated with a clonal lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate.
Muscle fibers show cross-striations and desmin/myogenin positivity rather than CD68-positive histiocytes filled with immunoglobulin crystals.
Fat necrosis histiocytes have foamy, clear vacuolated cytoplasm and lipid cysts, not dense eosinophilic crystalline cytoplasm.
Infectious histiocytoses show organisms on special stains or Michaelis-Gutmann bodies, whereas crystal-storing histiocytes contain light chain-restricted immunoglobulin crystals.

60737.recognize_zh: 移植前骨髓切片 (A) 骨小樑明顯增厚融合、骨髓腔被細胞浸潤，免疫染色 (B) 呈大片瀰漫陽性；移植後 (C) 骨小樑恢復纖細、脂肪空泡回復，免疫染色 (D) 只剩零星陽性，顯示全身性肥大細胞增生症的骨硬化在異體移植後消退。
features: Panel A (pre-HCT, H&E): markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bone trabeculae (osteosclerosis) with hypercellular marrow spaces
Panel B (pre-HCT, IHC, marker unlabeled): diffuse strong staining filling intertrabecular spaces, indicating extensive mast cell infiltration
Panel C (post-HCT, H&E): thin, regular trabeculae with normocellular marrow containing fat
Panel D (post-HCT, IHC, marker unlabeled): only scattered weak staining without dense aggregates
Low-power images only; individual mast cell spindle morphology cannot be assessed
60737.describe_en: The pretransplant bone marrow biopsy shows marked osteosclerosis with thickened, anastomosing trabeculae and intertrabecular spaces that are diffusely infiltrated and strongly positive on immunohistochemistry (marker not labeled, presumably a mast cell marker such as tryptase or CD117). The post-allogeneic transplant biopsy shows restoration of thin trabeculae, normocellular marrow with fat, and only scattered positive cells without compact aggregates. Findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis with osteosclerosis and its histologic regression after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation.

ddx.vs: PMF shows atypical megakaryocyte clusters with reticulin/collagen fibrosis and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations, without tryptase/CD25+ spindle mast cell aggregates or KIT D816V.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cytokeratin-positive epithelial nests in a desmoplastic stroma.
Metabolic bone disease shows osteoclastic resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis without a diffuse mast cell infiltrate.

60545.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中兩顆中型淋巴細胞，核圓形略不規則、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質量中等淡藍；本張放大倍率下細胞質顆粒不明顯，形態接近成熟淋巴球，需靠長期淋巴球增多與 NK 細胞表型診斷。
features: Two medium-sized lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin without visible nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale-blue cytoplasm; azurophilic granules not clearly resolved at this magnification
Red cells normochromic with central pallor and scattered stomatocyte-like slit forms
Scattered platelets; no blasts
60545.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells, some with slit-like central pallor, and adequate scattered platelets. Two medium-sized lymphocytes are present with round to slightly irregular nuclei, coarse mature chromatin, no nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm. Cytoplasmic azurophilic granules are not clearly resolved in this field, so large granular lymphocyte morphology is only suggested. In a patient with years of stable lymphocytosis and an NK-cell phenotype on flow cytometry, findings are consistent with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so separation relies on flow cytometry showing surface CD3 and a clonal TCR rearrangement in T-LGL versus sCD3-negative CD16/CD56+ NK cells with abnormal KIR expression.
ANKL presents acutely with cytopenias, organomegaly and EBV-positive atypical cells with open chromatin, unlike this indolent mature-appearing population.
Reactive LGL expansions are transient (e.g., viral, post-transplant) and polyclonal with normal KIR distribution.

60481.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高度細胞化，於脂肪細胞之間可見一群核圓形、細胞間距分開、周圍有透明細胞質的單核細胞（荷包蛋樣 fried egg），與殘存的紅血球系及顆粒球系混雜；此倍率下荷包蛋外觀僅部分可辨。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a diffuse interstitial mononuclear infiltrate between adipocytes
Infiltrating cells with round to oval, evenly spaced nuclei surrounded by pale/clear cytoplasm (fried-egg appearance)
Nuclei bland with fine chromatin; mitoses not evident
Residual erythroid and granulocytic precursors admixed; extravasated red cells
Bony trabecula at upper right; no paratrabecular aggregates
60481.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular and shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of mononuclear cells with round to oval, evenly spaced nuclei and pale to clear cytoplasm imparting a fried-egg appearance, admixed with residual trilineage hematopoiesis and extravasated red cells. No nodular or paratrabecular lymphoid aggregates are seen. The fried-egg morphology is only partially appreciable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia, to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (CD20, annexin A1, TRAP, BRAF V600E).

ddx.vs: Mast cell infiltrates are typically paratrabecular or perivascular spindled aggregates with eosinophils and fibrosis and are tryptase/CD117 positive.
SMZL forms nodular and intrasinusoidal infiltrates of small lymphocytes without the evenly spaced clear-cytoplasm pattern and is annexin A1 negative.
Myeloid neoplasms show dysplastic or clustered megakaryocytes and myeloid predominance rather than an interstitial B-cell infiltrate highlighted by CD20.

60353.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖為女性（XX，Y 欄空白）46 條染色體，箭頭指出 9 號染色體短臂與 11 號染色體長臂的交換（der(9)、der(11)），即 t(9;11)(p22;q23)，形成 KMT2A-MLLT3 融合。
features: G-banded karyogram with 46 chromosomes and two X chromosomes (no Y)
Arrow at the short arm of one chromosome 9 indicating altered 9p banding (der(9))
Arrow at the long arm of one chromosome 11 indicating altered 11q banding (der(11))
Interpretation: 46,XX,t(9;11)(p22;q23) involving KMT2A (MLL) and MLLT3 (AF9)
No additional clonal abnormalities apparent in this metaphase
60353.describe_en: This G-banded karyogram shows a female metaphase with 46 chromosomes and a reciprocal translocation between the short arm of chromosome 9 and the long arm of chromosome 11, with arrows marking the derivative chromosomes. The karyotype is 46,XX,t(9;11)(p22;q23). This rearrangement fuses KMT2A at 11q23 with MLLT3 at 9p22 and defines AML with t(9;11)(p22;q23); KMT2A-MLLT3, which typically shows monocytic or myelomonocytic differentiation and is more frequent in children. KMT2A break-apart FISH is useful to confirm the rearrangement, since the translocated segments are small and other 11q23 partners exist.

ddx.dx: AML with other KMT2A rearrangements (e.g., t(6;11), t(11;19))
ddx.vs: The partner chromosome differs, so identification of chromosome 9p22 involvement (or MLLT3 by molecular testing) separates t(9;11) from other 11q23 translocations.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related myeloid neoplasm with KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: The karyotype can be identical; a history of topoisomerase II inhibitor exposure defines the therapy-related category.

ddx.dx: Cryptic KMT2A partial tandem duplication or deletion 11q
ddx.vs: These alter 11q23 without a partner chromosome and are detected by molecular testing rather than a reciprocal exchange on karyotype.

60225.recognize_zh: 低倍下普魯士藍鐵染色的骨髓顆粒，含脂肪空泡與紅色對比染色的細胞，但整個顆粒內完全找不到藍色含鐵血黃素顆粒（no stainable iron），支持骨髓鐵儲存耗竭。
features: Low power bone marrow aspirate particle with fat vacuoles and red-counterstained hematopoietic cells
Complete absence of blue hemosiderin granules within the particle stroma and macrophages
Adequate particle present, allowing interpretation of storage iron
Sideroblast assessment not possible at this magnification
60225.describe_en: Low power view of a Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate shows a cellular particle containing fat spaces and red-counterstained hematopoietic cells. No blue-staining hemosiderin is identified within the particle or its macrophages. Evaluation of sideroblasts requires higher magnification. Absent stainable marrow iron in an adequate particle is consistent with iron deficiency.

ddx.vs: Shows preserved or increased blue macrophage iron in particles with reduced sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Technical false negative (aparticulate smear or decalcified core)
ddx.vs: Iron may be leached by acid decalcification or missed without particles, so the stain should be interpreted only on adequate aspirate particles with a positive control.
Marrow iron is typically increased with ring sideroblasts rather than absent.

60161.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎全為造血細胞、脂肪極少，紅血球系、顆粒球系增生並散在許多大小不一、分布較鬆散的巨核細胞，竇腔充滿紅血球；三系增生（panmyelosis）而無明顯纖維化，符合真性紅血球增多症。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with near-absent fat
Panmyelosis with expanded erythroid and granulocytic precursors
Increased, pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying size, scattered and loosely clustered, some with hyperlobated nuclei
Congested sinusoids filled with red cells
No obvious fibrosis, osteosclerosis or blast sheets
60161.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with trilineage hyperplasia. Megakaryocytes are increased and pleomorphic, ranging from small to large forms with hyperlobated nuclei, and are distributed singly and in loose clusters. Sinusoids are dilated and congested. No sheets of blasts or overt fibrosis are seen on H&E. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with panmyelosis, compatible with polycythemia vera, polycythemic phase.

ddx.vs: Features normocellular marrow with predominantly large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes and no significant erythroid or granulocytic proliferation.
Megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei in dense clusters, with granulocytic proliferation and reduced erythropoiesis.
Shows granulocytic predominance with small hypolobated (dwarf) megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1 fusion.

60097.recognize_zh: 視野內幾乎全為脂肪細胞，殘存造血細胞只沿脂肪間隙呈細條分布，看不到巨核細胞聚集或異常細胞浸潤；這是明顯低細胞性骨髓，符合 GATA2 缺乏症（Emberger syndrome）常見的低細胞骨髓表現。（此圖與 60089 為同一視野，僅色調不同。）
features: Markedly hypocellular marrow with near-total replacement by adipocytes
Residual hematopoiesis limited to narrow interstitial strands between fat cells
Residual cells mostly small round mononuclear cells with interstitial red cells
No megakaryocytes or dysplastic megakaryocyte clusters visible at this power
No fibrosis, blast aggregates, or granulomas
60097.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypocellular marrow in which the marrow space is almost entirely occupied by adipose tissue. Residual hematopoietic elements form thin interstitial strands composed predominantly of small mononuclear cells with interstitial hemorrhage; megakaryocytes are not identified in this field. There is no fibrosis or aggregate of blasts at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular marrow; in GATA2 deficiency (Emberger syndrome), assessment for hypocellular MDS requires evaluation of megakaryocyte dysplasia, CD34 immunostaining, and cytogenetics, and the typical monocytopenia and B/NK lymphopenia should be confirmed by flow cytometry. Note: this image appears to be the same microscopic field as record 60089 with different white balance.

ddx.vs: Histologically similar fatty marrow; GATA2 deficiency is suggested by profound monocytopenia, B- and NK-cell lymphopenia, atypical infections, lymphedema, and germline GATA2 mutation.
Requires dysplastic (often small, hypolobated) megakaryocytes, increased CD34+ cells, or clonal karyotype such as monosomy 7, which cannot be demonstrated in this fatty field.

ddx.dx: Dyskeratosis congenita / other telomere biology disorders
ddx.vs: Similar aplastic histology; separated by telomere length testing and germline sequencing rather than morphology.
HCL shows interstitial fried-egg lymphoid cells with reticulin fibrosis and CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positivity, not seen in this bland fatty marrow.

60033.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中 7 號位置只剩一條染色體，箭頭指向缺失的另一條，其餘染色體與性染色體 XY 皆成對正常，判讀為 45,XY,-7（單體 7），屬於定義 AML-MRC 的骨髓發育不良相關細胞遺傳異常。
features: G-banded karyotype with male sex chromosome complement (X and Y)
Only one chromosome 7 present; arrow marks the position of the missing homolog
All other autosomes present in pairs without visible structural rearrangement
Interpretation: 45,XY,-7 (monosomy 7)
60033.describe_en: G-banded karyotype from a single metaphase shows a male complement with loss of one chromosome 7, indicated by the arrow, and no other apparent numeric or structural abnormalities. The karyotype is interpreted as 45,XY,-7. Monosomy 7 is a myelodysplasia-related cytogenetic abnormality that, in the presence of 20% or more blasts, qualifies for acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes and confers adverse risk; confirmation across multiple metaphases is required to call a clone.

ddx.vs: Deletion of 7q retains a shortened chromosome 7, whereas here the entire homolog is absent.

ddx.dx: Random chromosome loss from metaphase preparation
ddx.vs: A single missing chromosome may be a technical artifact; by ISCN, loss must be seen in at least three metaphases to define a clone.
Morphology and karyotype cannot distinguish these; young age, family history, and germline testing are required.

20417.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小正常，內含多個紫紅色裂殖子（merozoites）圍繞一團棕黑色瘧色素（hemozoin）的裂殖體（schizont），旁邊紅血球可見細小環狀體；嗜中性球與單核球胞質內也吞有棕黑色色素顆粒，符合重度惡性瘧（P. falciparum）感染。
features: Mature schizonts within normal-sized, non-stippled red cells containing numerous small magenta merozoites clustered around a single dark brown-black pigment mass
Ruptured/rupturing schizont with free merozoites scattered adjacent to a pigment clump
Delicate ring form with a small chromatin dot in a neighboring red cell
Hemozoin (malaria pigment) phagocytosed within a neutrophil and within a monocyte
Host red cells not enlarged and lacking Schüffner stippling
20417.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells infected by mature schizonts containing multiple merozoites arranged around a single clump of dark brown-black pigment; one schizont appears ruptured with free merozoites. A delicate ring form is present in an adjacent erythrocyte, and infected red cells are of normal size without Schüffner dots. Brown-black hemozoin pigment is also seen within the cytoplasm of a neutrophil and a monocyte. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum infection; circulating schizonts and pigment-laden leukocytes indicate high parasite burden and severe malaria.

ddx.vs: P. vivax schizonts carry 12–24 larger merozoites in an enlarged red cell with Schüffner stippling, whereas falciparum-infected cells are normal-sized and schizonts are rarely seen in blood except in severe infection.
P. malariae forms rosette schizonts with about 8 merozoites around central pigment in small-to-normal red cells and shows band forms, with fewer ring forms.
Morphology overlaps (rings like falciparum, mature stages like malariae), so PCR and travel history to Southeast Asia are needed to separate it.
Babesia rings lack hemozoin pigment and schizonts and may form tetrad (Maltese cross) arrangements.

17601.recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示雙上臂廣泛融合的紅色斑丘疹（麻疹樣藥疹），胸腹部顏色較深但未見水疱或表皮剝落；配合使用 dapsone 的病史，才能推想為藥物反應伴嗜酸性白血球增多與全身症狀（DRESS），照片本身無法確立診斷。
features: Diffuse erythematous macular-papular (morbilliform) eruption on both upper limbs, coalescing into patches
Background of dusky erythema over the trunk
No visible bullae, target lesions, skin necrosis or epidermal detachment
Mucous membranes and face not shown, limiting assessment of SJS/TEN or facial edema
17601.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a widespread erythematous morbilliform eruption involving both arms, with coalescent macules and papules, and diffuse erythema of the trunk. No blisters, epidermal detachment or target lesions are visible, and the face and mucosa are not shown. The image alone is non-specific; in a patient receiving dapsone, it is compatible with drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS), which requires correlation with latency (2–8 weeks), fever, lymphadenopathy, eosinophilia or atypical lymphocytosis and organ involvement (RegiSCAR criteria).

ddx.vs: Uncomplicated exanthems lack fever, facial edema, eosinophilia, atypical lymphocytes and liver or kidney involvement.
SJS/TEN shows dusky targetoid lesions, blistering with Nikolsky sign and mucosal erosions, not seen here.
Viral rashes occur without new drug exposure, and serology/PCR helps, although HHV-6 reactivation also occurs in DRESS.
These cause cyanosis, bite cells and Heinz bodies rather than rash, and may coexist with DRESS.

22785.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下在脂肪為主的骨髓中散見多個肉芽腫，其中數個中央是一個透明圓形脂肪空泡、外圍環繞類上皮組織球與淋巴球，形成甜甜圈樣（doughnut / fibrin-ring）肉芽腫，是 Q 熱（Coxiella burnetii）的典型骨髓表現。
features: Low power: hypocellular fatty marrow with a bony trabecula and several discrete granulomas
Granulomas with a central, sharply round clear lipid vacuole (doughnut configuration)
Central vacuole rimmed by epithelioid histiocytes admixed with lymphocytes
A thin eosinophilic fibrin ring is not clearly resolved on H&E
No caseating necrosis or multinucleated giant cells evident
22785.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a hypocellular, fat-rich marrow containing multiple discrete non-necrotizing granulomas. Several granulomas have a central, round clear lipid vacuole surrounded by a rim of epithelioid histiocytes and lymphocytes, producing a doughnut configuration. A fibrin ring is not clearly seen on this H&E image and no caseation is present. Findings are consistent with fibrin-ring (doughnut) granulomas, characteristic of but not specific for Coxiella burnetii infection (Q fever); Coxiella serology/PCR, special stains for fibrin and microorganisms, and cultures are recommended.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas are often necrotizing with Langhans giant cells and lack a central fat vacuole with fibrin ring; AFB stain and culture separate them.
Lipogranulomas are small aggregates of lipid-laden macrophages around fat droplets without an organized epithelioid cuff or fibrin ring and are clinically incidental.

ddx.dx: EBV, CMV, leishmaniasis or drug (allopurinol) reactions
ddx.vs: These can also produce fibrin-ring granulomas, so serology, PCR and drug history are required to establish Q fever.
Hodgkin shows Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells and sarcoid shows compact tight granulomas without central fat vacuoles.

20993.recognize_zh: 血液抹片低倍（A–C）可見成團的腫瘤細胞群，乍看像循環中的癌細胞團（carcinocythemia）；放大（D、F）其實是核偏位、細胞質深藍的漿細胞聚集，骨髓抹片與切片（E、G、H）更見瀰漫性漿細胞浸潤，證實為漿細胞白血病。
features: Panels A-C: low-power blood smear with discrete clumps of nucleated cells among red cells, mimicking tumor cell clusters
Panel D: clump composed of cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm
Panels E-F: marrow aspirate with sheets and aggregates of plasma cells with perinuclear hof
Panels G-H: hypercellular biopsy with diffuse sheets of plasma cells replacing normal marrow
No glandular or keratinizing features in the clusters
20993.describe_en: Low-power views of the peripheral blood smear show tight clusters of nucleated cells mimicking circulating carcinoma cell aggregates. On higher power the clustered cells are plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate contains numerous plasma cells in aggregates, and the trephine biopsy is hypercellular with diffuse sheets of plasma cells. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia with clumping of circulating plasma cells masquerading as carcinocythemia; immunophenotyping (CD138, CD38, light chain restriction, cytokeratin negativity) confirms the lineage.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cell clusters show nuclear molding and cohesive epithelial borders and are cytokeratin-positive and CD138/CD45 variable, without a perinuclear hof.

ddx.dx: Circulating lymphoma cells (e.g., plasmablastic or large B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are usually discohesive and express B-cell markers or plasmablastic features with a high Ki-67.
Artifactual clumps consist of normal neutrophils or platelets and disappear in citrate-anticoagulated blood.
Small round cell tumors have scant cytoplasm and lack the eccentric nucleus and hof of plasma cells.

19393.recognize_zh: 血液抹片可見多顆核染色質呈粗塊狀（soccer-ball pattern）、細胞質極少的小淋巴球，以及三個破碎的污斑細胞（smudge cells），其中夾雜略大的淋巴樣細胞，符合慢性淋巴球白血病（CLL），並呈混合細胞型的傾向。
features: Small round lymphocytes with high N:C ratio and a thin rim of blue cytoplasm
Coarse, block-like clumped chromatin (soccer-ball pattern) without visible nucleoli
Occasional slightly larger lymphoid cell with less condensed chromatin
Three prominent smudge cells with disrupted streaky chromatin
Red cells normocytic with drying artifact; a small platelet present
19393.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of small lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarse block-like clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm, admixed with occasional slightly larger lymphoid cells. Numerous smudge cells are present. Red cells are normocytic with minor drying artifact. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; the presence of larger cells supports a mixed cell pattern, and the percentage of prolymphocytes and the flow cytometric CLL score (CD5, CD23, CD200, dim sIg, FMC7-negative) should be documented.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are polymorphous with abundant cytoplasm and few smudge cells, and are polytypic by flow cytometry.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells usually have more irregular or notched nuclei with finer chromatin and are cyclin D1-positive, CD23-negative, and CD200-negative.
Circulating follicular lymphoma cells are small with deeply cleaved (buttock-like) nuclei and are CD10-positive and CD5-negative.

15169.recognize_zh: 這是周邊血流式細胞儀 FLAER 分析：先以 FSC/SSC 與 CD15/CD33 區分顆粒球（綠）與單核球（藍），再看 CD24 或 CD14 對 FLAER；落在左下角 FLAER 陰性、CD24/CD14 陰性框內的族群即 GPI 缺失的 PNH clone。A–D 只有小族群（再生不良性貧血合併 2% clone），E–H 大部分細胞都在陰性框內（典型 PNH）。
features: Panels A/E: FSC vs SSC gating of leukocytes, granulocytes (green) and monocytes (blue)
Panels B/F: CD15 vs CD33 separating granulocytes (CD15 bright) from monocytes (CD33 bright)
Panel C: granulocytes mostly CD24+/FLAER+ with a small CD24-/FLAER- population in the lower-left gate (~2% clone)
Panel D: monocytes mostly CD14+/FLAER+ with few events in the negative gate
Panels G/H: most granulocytes are CD24-/FLAER- and most monocytes are CD14-/FLAER-, indicating a large PNH clone
Non-morphologic figure (flow cytometry dot plots)
15169.describe_en: Multiparameter flow cytometry of peripheral blood leukocytes. Granulocytes (green) and monocytes (blue) are identified by light scatter and CD15/CD33 expression (A, B, E, F), then assessed for the GPI-anchored marker CD24 (granulocytes) or CD14 (monocytes) against FLAER, which binds the GPI anchor directly. In the aplastic anemia patient (C, D), the majority of granulocytes and monocytes retain CD24/CD14 and FLAER, with a small double-negative population in the lower-left gate representing a ~2% PNH clone. In the classic PNH patient (G, H), most granulocytes and monocytes fall within the CD24-/FLAER- and CD14-/FLAER- gates, indicating a large GPI-deficient clone. Findings are consistent with a small PNH clone in aplastic anemia (A-D) and classic PNH (E-H).

14017.recognize_zh: 血小板低下的男孩周邊血中，血小板體積大、呈淡灰藍色且幾乎看不到紫紅色顆粒（右圖放大），旁邊中性球顆粒正常，符合灰色血小板症候群（gray platelet syndrome，α 顆粒缺乏，NBEAL2 變異）。
features: Enlarged platelets, some approaching red cell size (macrothrombocytes)
Platelet cytoplasm is pale gray-blue and nearly devoid of azurophilic (alpha) granules
Platelet number reduced in the field
Neutrophil with normal granulation and segmentation, without Döhle-like inclusions
Red cells normochromic with a few showing mild shape variation
14017.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows reduced platelets, many of which are enlarged, with pale gray-blue cytoplasm that is nearly devoid of azurophilic granules. The neutrophil present shows normal granulation and lacks Döhle-like inclusions, and red cells are largely unremarkable. These findings are consistent with gray platelet syndrome, an alpha-granule deficiency typically due to biallelic NBEAL2 variants; electron microscopy or immunofluorescence for alpha-granule proteins and genetic testing provide confirmation.

ddx.dx: Artifactual platelet degranulation (EDTA storage or poor staining)
ddx.vs: In-vitro degranulation affects platelets of normal size and is corrected on a fresh citrated smear, whereas GPS platelets are large and consistently agranular.
MYH9 disease has giant but normally granulated platelets and neutrophil Döhle-like inclusions.
BSS has giant granulated platelets with absent ristocetin agglutination due to GPIb-IX-V deficiency.
MDS shows hypogranular platelets alongside dysplastic neutrophils and other lineage abnormalities in an older patient.

13505.recognize_zh: 三色染色中，骨髓腔被藍色膠原纖維取代並呈流線狀排列，其間有擴張的竇狀血管（內含紅血球）；兩側骨小樑增厚、不規則（紅色基質、藍色邊緣），表示膠原纖維化合併骨硬化，是原發性骨髓纖維化纖維化期（MF-3）的表現。
features: Intertrabecular space replaced by blue-staining collagen fibers in a streaming pattern
Dilated, tortuous sinusoids containing red cells and occasional nucleated cells
Scattered spindle and small hematopoietic nuclei within the fibrotic stroma; hematopoiesis markedly reduced
Thickened, irregular bony trabeculae (red) with blue-staining osteoid-like margins, indicating osteosclerosis
Scattered fat vacuoles; megakaryocyte morphology cannot be judged at this magnification
13505.describe_en: Masson trichrome-stained bone marrow trephine section shows extensive blue collagen fibrosis with a streaming arrangement that replaces most of the hematopoietic space. Dilated, tortuous sinusoids containing red cells are prominent. The adjacent bony trabeculae are thickened and irregular with new bone formation at their margins. Findings are consistent with collagen fibrosis and osteosclerosis (MF-3), as seen in the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis; correlation with reticulin grade, megakaryocyte morphology, leukoerythroblastic blood picture and driver mutation status is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histology is similar; the diagnosis depends on documented antecedent polycythemia vera or essential thrombocythemia.
Osteitis fibrosa shows peritrabecular fibrosis with osteoclastic resorption (tunneling) and preserved central hematopoiesis rather than diffuse streaming collagen with dilated sinusoids.
Mastocytosis forms paratrabecular or perivascular fibrotic lesions containing spindle mast cells that are tryptase and CD25 positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma (e.g. breast, prostate) with osteosclerosis
ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma shows keratin-positive epithelial clusters within the fibrosis.

3457.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆邊界不規則的巨噬細胞，細胞質淡藍且多空泡，內含深藍色顆粒狀碎屑與大小不一的深染小圓體（凋亡核碎片），屬吞噬碎屑的組織球（debris-laden histiocyte）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular, frayed borders
Cytoplasm containing coarse dark blue granular debris and numerous small dense round bodies of varying size (apoptotic nuclear fragments)
Macrophage nucleus partly obscured by overlying cells
No intact engulfed red cells or whole nucleated cells clearly identified
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils), erythroid precursors and red cells
3457.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing coarse blue granular debris and numerous small dense round nuclear fragments of varying size. No intact phagocytosed cells are clearly identified. The background shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with a debris-laden histiocyte, a nonspecific marker of increased cell turnover or apoptosis (e.g. after chemotherapy, ineffective hematopoiesis or high-grade neoplasm).

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytic histiocytes contain intact red cells, platelets or whole nucleated cells, rather than fragmented nuclear debris.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules of ceroid pigment that stain with PAS and Sudan black, without apoptotic nuclear fragments.
Gaucher cells have a small eccentric nucleus and fibrillary crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm without discrete debris or vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophage in Burkitt or high-grade lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphologically the same cell; the context is defined by a background of sheets of lymphoma cells, which is not present in this field.

1793.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織之間散布大量淡染、細胞質豐富的組織球，成片或單個出現（箭頭所指），細胞質呈淡粉灰色、略帶纖維感，取代部分骨髓空間，符合 Gaucher 細胞浸潤。
features: Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale, lightly eosinophilic-grey cytoplasm scattered singly and in clusters (arrows)
Histiocytes have small, round, eccentric nuclei and faintly fibrillary cytoplasm
Interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate displacing hematopoietic elements
Residual trilineage hematopoiesis between the histiocytes
Bony trabeculae without evident osteolysis at this magnification
1793.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows hypercellular marrow with bony trabeculae and an interstitial and focally sheet-like infiltrate of large pale histiocytes (arrows). The histiocytes contain abundant pale, faintly fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, and they displace the residual trilineage hematopoiesis. No atypical lymphoid infiltrate or granulomas are seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by Gaucher cells in the setting of Gaucher disease.

ddx.vs: These look similar on H&E, so they are separated by the accompanying neoplastic population (myeloid hyperplasia or plasma cells) and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick foam cells have bubbly, vacuolated cytoplasm rather than the finely fibrillary cytoplasm of Gaucher cells.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial infection (e.g. MAI in immunocompromised hosts)
ddx.vs: Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes can mimic Gaucher cells but contain acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with atypical nuclei and are cytokeratin-positive, whereas Gaucher cells are bland and CD68/CD163-positive.

1665.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見數顆核偏心、染色質呈塊狀（clock-face）、細胞質呈灰藍至深藍色的細胞，部分核旁有淡染的高基氏區，左下大細胞細胞質豐富並含空泡；這些偏心核、嗜鹼性細胞質的特徵指向漿細胞，但本圖細胞重疊、典型度有限。
features: Several cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderately abundant grey-blue to deeply basophilic cytoplasm (upper right)
Coarse, clumped 'clock-face' chromatin in some nuclei; nucleoli inconspicuous
Large cell at lower left with eccentric nucleus and abundant cytoplasm containing clear vacuoles
Central cell with pale vacuolated cytoplasm overlapped by several nuclei, making cell boundaries difficult to assign
Background of other marrow precursors and a lymphocyte-sized cell with dense chromatin
1665.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a group of cells including forms with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and grey-blue to basophilic cytoplasm consistent with plasma cells. A large cell at the lower left has abundant vacuolated cytoplasm with an eccentric nucleus, and a central cell with pale vacuolated cytoplasm is overlapped by several nuclei, which limits confident assignment of individual cells. A well-defined perinuclear hof is not clearly seen in every cell. Findings are consistent with plasma cells in a marrow aspirate; quantitation and light chain studies would be required to assess for a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are larger with a pale hof located away from the nucleus and occur in loose clusters near bone, whereas plasma cells have a hof abutting the nucleus and smaller size.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes are smaller with scant cytoplasm and are mixed with small lymphocytes and mast cells.
A macrophage has a single bland nucleus with phagocytosed material, while overlapping nuclei here belong to separate cells.

1345.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血抹片中，箭頭指出頭盔形細胞（helmet cell）與三角形紅血球碎片（schistocytes），視野中血小板很少，符合 TTP 的微血管病性溶血。
features: Schistocytes including helmet cells and a small triangular fragment (arrows)
Additional red cells with a straight cut edge or irregular contour
Anisocytosis with some larger red cells, likely reticulocytes
Markedly reduced platelets; only a single platelet in the field
Mononuclear cell at the lower left with a folded nucleus and fine cytoplasmic granules
1345.describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows schistocytes, including helmet cells and a small triangular fragment (arrows), along with several red cells bearing straight cut edges. There is anisocytosis with some larger red cells suggestive of reticulocytes, and platelets are markedly decreased, with only a single platelet visible. A mononuclear cell with a folded nucleus is present, and no blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia, as seen in thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

ddx.vs: DIC shows similar fragments but with prolonged PT/aPTT, hypofibrinogenemia and high D-dimer.
Morphology is identical; renal-predominant disease and ADAMTS13 activity above 10% favor HUS.
Bite cells have a semicircular 'bite' removed from an otherwise intact cell, often with blister cells and Heinz bodies, rather than sharp-cornered helmet and triangular fragments.

1217.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆細胞核呈摺疊、腎形或馬蹄形，染色質細緻，胞質灰藍且量多（promonocytes/單核球），並混有一顆核圓、胞質少的母細胞與一顆分葉異常的顆粒球；循環中同時出現未成熟單核系與顆粒系細胞，支持 AMML。
features: Several large cells with folded, reniform or horseshoe-shaped nuclei and delicate chromatin (promonocytes/immature monocytes)
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with faint fine granules and irregular borders
Admixed smaller blast with round nucleus, high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Granulocytic cell with abnormally clumped, lobulated nucleus and pale cytoplasm
Red cells with mild anisocytosis; platelets sparse
1217.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased circulating immature cells. Most are large with abundant gray-blue, faintly granular cytoplasm and folded, reniform or horseshoe-shaped nuclei with delicate chromatin, consistent with promonocytes and immature monocytes. A blast with a round nucleus and scant basophilic cytoplasm and a granulocytic cell with an abnormally lobulated nucleus and pale cytoplasm are also present. Platelets appear decreased. In correlation with the marrow, findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia; monocytic and granulocytic differentiation should be confirmed by nonspecific esterase and MPO or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: CMML shows mature monocytes with clumped chromatin and <20% blasts plus promonocytes, whereas these monocytic cells have delicate immature chromatin.
Requires >=80% monocytic cells in marrow with minimal granulocytic component, a proportion that cannot be judged from this blood field.
Reactive monocytes are mature with condensed chromatin and vacuolated cytoplasm, without blasts, promonocytes or dysplastic granulocytes.

1281.recognize_zh: 低倍抹片中有許多中到大型、核不規則的非典型淋巴樣細胞，部分細胞質含嗜天青顆粒，並夾雜碎裂的核與空泡狀殘渣，提示伴有壞死的淋巴瘤；單憑此圖無法確立 NK/T 細胞譜系。
features: Numerous medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented or convoluted nuclei
Moderate amounts of pale blue cytoplasm; some cells contain azurophilic granules
Frequent smudged, crushed and fragmented nuclei suggestive of necrosis/apoptosis
Scattered clear vacuoles and granular debris in the background
Loosely clustered cells among red cells without cohesive epithelial groups
1281.describe_en: Smear preparation at low-to-intermediate magnification shows a cellular population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, some containing azurophilic granules. There are numerous smudged and fragmented nuclei with background vacuoles and granular debris, suggesting necrosis. No cohesive epithelial clusters are seen. The lineage cannot be established morphologically at this magnification; immunophenotyping (cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, cytotoxic markers) and EBER in situ hybridization are required. Findings are suggestive of a high-grade lymphoma and compatible with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma in the clinical context.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are usually agranular with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, and are CD20/PAX5-positive and EBER variably negative, whereas ENKTL cells may carry azurophilic granules and are CD56+/EBER+.
PTCL-NOS can look identical but typically lacks the angiocentric necrosis-associated pattern and is EBER-negative with surface CD3 expression.
Reactive lesions show a polymorphous mix of small lymphocytes, neutrophils and histiocytes rather than a dominant population of large atypical lymphoid cells.

1089.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆顆粒稀少的嗜中性球，核呈雙葉且染色質濃縮（假性Pelger-Huët），背景紅血球可見棘狀紅血球（echinocytes）；這是JMML可見的發育不良線索，但單一視野不足以診斷。
features: Single mature granulocyte with a bilobed, spectacle-like nucleus and coarsely clumped chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-Huët form)
Pale cytoplasm with reduced visible granulation (hypogranular)
Scattered crenated red cells/echinocytes and mild anisocytosis
Few platelets; no blasts or monocytes present in this field
1089.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus connected by a thin bridge, dense clumped chromatin, and pale hypogranular cytoplasm, consistent with a pseudo-Pelger-Huët cell. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with scattered echinocytes, and platelets appear reduced in this field. No monocytes, immature myeloid cells, or blasts are present in the field shown. In a child with monocytosis and splenomegaly, dysgranulopoiesis of this type supports juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, but the field alone is not diagnostic.

ddx.vs: The inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and normal counts, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are a subset accompanied by hypogranulation and cytopenias.
Drug-related forms occur without monocytosis or splenomegaly and resolve on withdrawal; history and RAS-pathway mutation testing separate them from JMML.
CMML shows similar dysplasia but occurs in older adults; JMML is pediatric with elevated HbF and RAS-pathway mutations.

1025.recognize_zh: 視野中大量大型原紅血球：圓核、細緻染色質、胞質呈深藍色且邊緣更藍，部分有核周淡染區，旁邊夾雜較成熟的紅血球母細胞（棋盤狀染色質），呈現紅血球系大量增生的母細胞族群。
features: Numerous large proerythroblasts with high N:C ratio, round central nuclei, and fine chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm, darker at the periphery, with occasional perinuclear pallor
Admixed later erythroblasts with coarse checkered chromatin and polychromatic cytoplasm
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; granulocytic precursors are infrequent
1025.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of large immature erythroid cells. The predominant cells are proerythroblasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous to small nucleoli, and a rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm, with occasional small vacuoles. Maturing basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts with clumped chromatin are admixed, while myeloid precursors are scant. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid type).

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less basophilic cytoplasm, may contain granules or Auer rods, and are MPO/CD13/CD33 positive rather than CD71/glycophorin A/E-cadherin positive.
Megaloblastic anemia shows full erythroid maturation with giant bands and hypersegmented neutrophils rather than a predominance of proerythroblasts.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Giant pronormoblasts with viral inclusions are scattered among a marrow lacking later erythroid stages, not sheets of proerythroblasts with dysplastic maturation.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clusters and lack erythroid markers, whereas these cells are dispersed and show a continuum of erythroid maturation.

4225.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一個香蕉形／新月形的蟲體，內含棒狀深色瘧色素，宿主紅血球被撐長只剩一圈淡邊，這是惡性瘧原蟲配子體（crescent gametocyte）的典型形態。
features: Crescent/banana-shaped intraerythrocytic parasite, a P. falciparum gametocyte
Dark rod-like hemozoin pigment granules within the parasite
Host red cell membrane visible as a faint rim around the crescent
Surrounding red cells normocytic without ring forms or stippling in this field
4225.describe_en: Smear shows a single crescent-shaped (banana-shaped) intraerythrocytic parasite containing dark rod-like hemozoin pigment, with the host red cell outline visible as a faint rim. Surrounding red cells are normocytic and no ring forms are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium falciparum gametocyte, diagnostic of falciparum malaria; parasitemia should be quantified on peripheral blood films.

ddx.vs: Vivax and ovale gametocytes are round and fill an enlarged red cell with Schuffner dots rather than being crescent-shaped.
P. malariae band trophozoites lie across a normal-sized red cell as a straight band, not a curved crescent with rounded ends.
Babesia produces small rings and tetrads without hemozoin pigment or gametocytes.

4033.recognize_zh: 高倍鐵染色（Prussian blue）下，數顆紅血球系前驅細胞的細胞核外圍被一圈藍黑色鐵顆粒環繞，形成典型的環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）；這是 MDS 伴環狀鐵粒母細胞與 MDS/MPN-RS-T 的診斷關鍵。
features: Erythroid precursors with coarse blue-black iron granules forming a complete or near-complete perinuclear ring
Granules number well over five and encircle more than one-third of the nucleus
Other precursors with fewer, partially perinuclear granules
Pink counterstained nuclei and cytoplasm in background
Slight blur limits fine detail
4033.describe_en: Prussian blue iron stain of the bone marrow aspirate at high power shows several erythroid precursors with numerous coarse siderotic granules arranged in a ring around the nucleus. These meet the criteria for ring sideroblasts (at least 5 granules encircling at least one-third of the nuclear circumference). Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts, which in a clonal context support myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts or MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts have only 1-4 fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than a perinuclear ring.
Ring sideroblasts are morphologically identical; congenital onset, microcytosis and lack of SF3B1 mutation distinguish it.

ddx.dx: Reversible sideroblastic anemia (copper deficiency, zinc excess, alcohol, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts look the same; causes are identified by history and resolve after correction, often with cytoplasmic vacuolization of precursors.

3905.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中散布許多中至大型異常淋巴樣細胞，核不規則、胞質嗜鹼性，大小明顯超過一般淋巴球，還有好幾顆破裂的細胞，這種易碎的大細胞群符合大細胞淋巴瘤的白血病期。
features: Increased numbers of medium to large atypical mononuclear cells scattered across the smear
Irregular, angulated nuclei with moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous smudged/disrupted cells reflecting fragility
Few normal neutrophils; red cells show rouleaux-like stacking and drying artifact
Nuclear detail and nucleoli not resolvable at this low magnification
3905.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows increased numbers of medium to large atypical mononuclear cells with irregular nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, accompanied by several smudged cells. Normal neutrophils are infrequent. Fine chromatin and nucleolar features cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of circulating lymphoma cells, consistent with the leukemic phase of large cell lymphoma, and should be confirmed by high-power review and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Low power cannot separate large lymphoma cells from blasts; immunophenotyping for CD34/TdT versus mature B-cell markers is required.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with smudge cells
ddx.vs: CLL cells are uniformly small with scant cytoplasm and clumped chromatin rather than large cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes show a heterogeneous spectrum with abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and are polyclonal on flow cytometry.

3969.recognize_zh: 高倍抹片中箭頭指的紅血球裡血紅素濃縮成深色、邊緣平直的結晶，並有指狀突起伸出細胞外，旁邊是明顯的靶形紅血球與濃縮的三角形細胞，這是 HbSC 結晶的特寫。
features: Dense hemoglobin crystals with blunt, straight-edged, finger-like projections (arrows)
Crystal-containing cells with pale residual cytoplasm
Numerous target cells with central hemoglobin dot
Dense irregularly contracted/triangular cells and a folded cell
Occasional platelets; a large polychromatic cell
3969.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows red cells with dense hemoglobin crystals having straight edges and blunt, finger-like projections extending beyond the cell outline (arrows). The background contains numerous target cells, dense irregularly contracted cells and a polychromatic red cell. Classic thin sickle cells are not present in this field. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin SC disease with characteristic SC crystals.

ddx.vs: HbC crystals are single hexagonal or rhomboid rods with parallel sides lying within the cell, without the multiple finger-like projections of SC crystals.
HbSS sickle cells are thin, curved and pointed at both ends rather than dense blunt crystalline forms.
Schistocytes are small uniformly dense fragments with sharp torn edges, without a crystal inside a pale membrane ghost.

3841.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，許多圓形細胞呈清楚的膜狀棕色陽性，單個或小群散布於間質、未形成大片，推測為 CD138 標示的漿細胞增加，符合反應性漿細胞增多的分布。
features: Numerous cells with crisp membranous brown staining (presumed CD138) scattered throughout the marrow
Positive cells distributed interstitially, singly and in small loose groups
No confluent sheets or large nodular aggregates of positive cells
Estimated positive cells a substantial minority (roughly 20-30%) of marrow cellularity
Hematoxylin-counterstained negative hematopoietic cells in background
3841.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on the bone marrow core biopsy, presumed CD138, highlights numerous plasma cells with membranous positivity. The positive cells are distributed interstitially, singly and in small loose clusters, without sheets or large nodules. Plasma cells appear increased, estimated at roughly 20-30% of cellularity in this field. The interstitial distribution favors a reactive plasmacytosis, as in HIV infection, but kappa/lambda in situ hybridization or immunostaining is required to exclude a clonal plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Myeloma is monotypic on kappa/lambda staining and often forms clusters or sheets with aberrant CD56 or cyclin D1 expression.
LPL shows CD20-positive small B-cell aggregates with admixed monotypic plasma cells and MYD88 L265P mutation.
Plasmablastic lymphoma forms diffuse sheets of large CD138-positive cells with high Ki-67 and often EBER positivity.

3777.recognize_zh: 這顆細胞比嗜中性球大，核呈折疊或腎形、染色質細緻如花邊，細胞質灰藍色、含多個小空泡且邊緣不規則，是正常單核球的典型外觀。
features: Large cell, roughly two to three times the diameter of a red cell
Folded, indented nucleus with fine lacy (open) chromatin; no distinct nucleoli
Moderate N:C ratio with abundant grey-blue ('ground-glass') cytoplasm
Multiple small cytoplasmic vacuoles and very fine dust-like granules
Irregular cytoplasmic border with small pseudopod-like projections; background normocytic red cells
3777.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large mononuclear cell with a folded nucleus, finely reticulated chromatin without prominent nucleoli, and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm containing scattered small vacuoles and fine granules. The cytoplasmic outline is irregular. Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with a normal mature monocyte.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have more delicate chromatin, visible nucleoli and less vacuolation, and are counted as blast equivalents.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, without ground-glass vacuolated cytoplasm.
Granulocytes have pink cytoplasm with specific granules and coarser, clumped chromatin rather than grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm.

3649.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞豐富，可見顆粒球系從骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核到分葉核的完整成熟序列，夾雜核深染圓形的紅血球前驅細胞，無芽細胞增加或單一細胞族群佔優勢，屬正常三系造血的成人骨髓。
features: Cellular aspirate smear with orderly granulocytic maturation from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and polychromatic cytoplasm interspersed
Granulocytic predominance with an apparently normal myeloid-to-erythroid ratio
No increase in blasts, no dysplastic forms, and no abnormal infiltrate
Scattered fat vacuoles; no megakaryocyte in this field
3649.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular spread with mixed hematopoietic elements. Granulocytic precursors show orderly maturation through myelocyte, metamyelocyte, band, and segmented stages, with interspersed erythroid precursors displaying normal maturation. Blasts are not increased, no dysplasia is evident, and no abnormal cell population is identified; megakaryocytes are not present in this field and should be assessed at low power. Findings are consistent with normal adult bone marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis.

ddx.vs: Shows increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio with toxic granulation and left shift, which are not evident here.
Shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with myelocyte bulge, basophilia, and small hypolobated megakaryocytes.
Requires dysplasia such as hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and megaloblastoid or ringed erythroid precursors, none seen here.

3713.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆圓至不規則形的細胞核完全沒有包圍的細胞質，染色質呈模糊的網狀、邊界略毛糙，散落在紅血球與脂肪空泡之間，這些就是抹片時破裂造成的裸核（naked nuclei）。
features: Multiple bare nuclei without any surrounding cytoplasm
Nuclei round to irregular, some with smudged or finely reticular chromatin and ragged edges
Nuclei are roughly lymphocyte to myelocyte size, precluding reliable lineage assignment
Fat vacuoles and spread red cells in a thin background with scattered platelets
A few smeared/crushed cells with streaming chromatin at the periphery
3713.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous bare (naked) nuclei lacking cytoplasm, with smudged to finely reticular chromatin, scattered among red cells and fat vacuoles; several crushed cells with streaming chromatin are also present. These represent cells disrupted during smear preparation. Naked nuclei cannot be reliably classified and should be excluded from the differential count. Frequent naked nuclei can indicate a traumatic smear or fragile cells, such as blasts or lymphoma cells, and a better-preserved area should be examined.

ddx.vs: Intact blasts retain a rim of basophilic cytoplasm and show fine chromatin with nucleoli, whereas naked nuclei lack cytoplasm and cannot be counted as blasts.
Intact lymphocytes have a thin but visible cytoplasmic rim and coarsely clumped chromatin rather than smudged chromatin without cytoplasm.
Smudge cells are flattened, spread-out lymphocyte nuclei typically seen in large numbers in peripheral blood of CLL, whereas these are scattered bare nuclei in a marrow aspirate.

3521.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓細胞豐富，除了各階段成熟的顆粒球系與紅血球系外，混有不少大小不一、核形不規則的淋巴樣細胞；單憑此圖無法確認淋巴瘤，需搭配切片與流式細胞儀。
features: Cellular aspirate with maturing granulocytic elements (myelocytes to segmented neutrophils)
Numerous round, dark erythroid precursors
Scattered medium to large mononuclear cells with irregular nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, some possibly atypical lymphoid cells
Occasional eosinophils
Low magnification limits nuclear detail; atypical lymphoid cells not clearly separable from normal precursors
3521.describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with trilineage hematopoiesis, including maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements and occasional eosinophils. Scattered medium to large mononuclear cells with irregular nuclear contours are present, which may represent atypical lymphoid cells, but they cannot be confidently distinguished from normal precursors at this magnification. Morphology alone is insufficient; correlation with the trephine biopsy, immunohistochemistry, and flow cytometry is needed to document involvement by peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are polyclonal with a normal T-cell antigen profile, whereas PTCL shows aberrant antigen loss on flow cytometry and clonal TCR rearrangement.
AITL shows a TFH phenotype (CD10, PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) with EBV-positive B cells, which requires immunophenotyping rather than aspirate morphology.
A myeloid neoplasm would show increased blasts or dysplasia in granulocytes rather than a distinct atypical lymphoid population.

3329.recognize_zh: 低倍率 H&E 脾臟切片呈瀰漫性紅髓浸潤，整片被單一形態的小到中型淋巴樣細胞充滿，其間散布大量紅血球湖（blood lakes），看不到白髓濾泡結節；紅髓瀰漫浸潤是毛細胞白血病及其變異型在脾臟的特徵。
features: Diffuse, uniform cellular infiltrate throughout the field without identifiable white pulp nodules
Monotonous small to intermediate cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
Numerous small irregular pools of extravasated red cells (blood lakes/pseudosinuses)
Red pulp cords and sinuses obscured by the infiltrate
No necrosis or granulomas evident at this magnification
3329.describe_en: Section of spleen at low power shows diffuse expansion of the red pulp by a monotonous infiltrate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm. Numerous small irregular pools of extravasated red cells (blood lakes) are scattered throughout, and white pulp follicles are not identified in this field. There is no necrosis or granulomatous inflammation. Findings are consistent with diffuse red pulp involvement by a small B-cell neoplasm, in context hairy cell leukemia variant; immunohistochemistry is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: SMZL primarily expands the white pulp as biphasic nodules with marginal zone differentiation, with only secondary red pulp involvement.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL has an identical red pulp pattern and requires immunophenotype (CD103, CD123, CD25, annexin A1) and cytology for separation.
HSTCL infiltrates red pulp sinusoids with CD3+ gamma-delta T cells and lacks B-cell markers.
EMH shows trilineage precursors including megakaryocytes and erythroid islands rather than a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate.

3201.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆嗜酸性球，細胞質充滿橘紅色粗顆粒，細胞核兩葉在上方凹陷、下方併攏成心形（heart-shaped nucleus）；這是雙葉核尚未完全分開的正常形態變異，不代表病理意義，背景紅血球中央淡染區偏大。
features: Single eosinophil slightly larger than surrounding red cells
Cytoplasm packed with coarse refractile orange-red granules
Nucleus with two incompletely separated lobes forming a heart shape
Moderately condensed chromatin without nucleoli
Background red cells with prominent central pallor and a few larger polychromatic cells
3201.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an eosinophil with coarse orange-red cytoplasmic granules and a nucleus composed of two incompletely separated lobes that together form a heart shape. The chromatin is moderately condensed without nucleoli, and the granules are evenly distributed. Background red cells show prominent central pallor with a few larger polychromatic forms. Findings represent a heart-shaped eosinophil, a normal morphologic variant of bilobed eosinophil nuclear segmentation without specific clinical significance.

ddx.vs: Pelger-Huet cells show symmetric spectacle-shaped bilobed or round nuclei with very coarse chromatin across all granulocytes, not an isolated heart-shaped eosinophil.
Basophil granules are dark purple-black and obscure the nucleus, unlike the orange-red eosinophilic granules here.
Toxic granules are dark blue-purple and finer, in neutrophils with three to five nuclear lobes.
Dysplastic eosinophils show hypogranularity, vacuolization or basophilic-staining granules, which are absent here.

3137.recognize_zh: 高倍下中央一顆紅血球內有邊緣平直、深染的長方形結晶，其餘胞內區域近乎空白（像「金條在盒中」），周圍多為標靶細胞與摺疊細胞，符合血紅素C結晶。
features: Single red cell containing a dense, dark rectangular crystal with straight parallel edges and a clear residual cell outline
Many target cells with central hemoglobin condensation
Folded and irregularly contracted red cells
Occasional small spherocytic cells and a teardrop-like fragment
Scattered platelets; no sickle cells
3137.describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells and folded cells. A central red cell contains a sharply marginated, dark-staining rectangular crystal, with the rest of the cell appearing pale and empty. No sickle cells or irregular SC-type crystals are seen. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin C crystals of homozygous hemoglobin C disease.

ddx.vs: SC crystals are irregular with blunt, finger-like projections rather than a regular rectangular or hexagonal outline.
These are small round dots, not a large geometric crystal filling much of the cell.
Overlap produces a denser zone with curved borders and no empty residual cell membrane.

2625.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央四顆紅血球前驅細胞，細胞質深藍、核圓，染色質比同階段應有的更細緻（megaloblastoid），旁邊有正常顆粒球；Wright染色看不到環狀鐵粒母細胞，須以Prussian blue鐵染色確認MDS-RS。
features: Cluster of four early erythroid precursors (basophilic to early polychromatic normoblasts)
Round central nuclei with moderately fine, open chromatin suggesting megaloblastoid change
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm, one cell with a slightly paler perinuclear zone
Adjacent granulocytic elements (band neutrophil, myelocytes) appear unremarkable
Ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed on this Romanowsky-stained smear
2625.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of basophilic and early polychromatic erythroid precursors with round nuclei, relatively fine chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, suggestive of mild megaloblastoid dyserythropoiesis. Accompanying granulocytic precursors, including a band neutrophil and myelocytes, show no obvious dysplasia in this field. No iron stain is provided, so ring sideroblasts cannot be evaluated here. The findings are compatible with, but not diagnostic of, myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts; a Prussian blue stain to quantify ring sideroblasts and SF3B1 mutation testing are required.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows marked nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and corrects with vitamin replacement.

ddx.dx: Congenital or acquired non-clonal sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, copper deficiency, drugs)
ddx.vs: These may show identical ring sideroblasts, so history, copper/zinc levels, and absence of SF3B1 or cytogenetic clonality are needed to separate them.
Reactive erythroid hyperplasia shows synchronous nuclear maturation with progressively condensed chromatin and no ring sideroblasts on iron stain.

2177.recognize_zh: 高倍下小腸絨毛固有層充滿中型、核深染不規則的非典型淋巴球，並大量進入表面上皮使上皮變得空泡化、排列紊亂，這種上皮親和性的 T 細胞浸潤是腸病相關 T 細胞淋巴瘤的重要線索。
features: Dense lamina propria infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphocytes
Hyperchromatic, irregular to angulated nuclei with scant cytoplasm
Prominent intraepithelial infiltration by atypical cells
Vacuolated, disrupted surface enterocytes
Dilated congested capillaries within villous cores
2177.describe_en: Section of small-intestinal mucosa at high power shows villous cores densely infiltrated by medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Many atypical cells infiltrate the surface epithelium, which is vacuolated and disrupted. Dilated congested capillaries are seen within the villi, without a prominent mixed inflammatory component. Findings are consistent with enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma; confirmation by T-cell immunophenotyping (CD3+, often CD4-/CD8-, CD56-, CD30 variable) is recommended.

ddx.vs: MEITL cells are monomorphic with pale cytoplasm and express CD8, CD56 and often MATK, whereas EATL is typically CD56 negative with more pleomorphism.
RCD II intraepithelial lymphocytes are small and cytologically bland despite an aberrant phenotype, without a destructive lamina propria infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving bowel
ddx.vs: ALCL is composed of large hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong uniform CD30, often ALK positive.

2049.recognize_zh: 密集成片的小到中型淋巴球，核圓、染色質呈粗塊狀（soccer-ball / cracked-mud chromatin）、細胞質極少且淡藍；右下角混有一顆較大的細胞，右上可見一顆含顆粒的細胞，整體以單一小淋巴球為主，符合 CLL/SLL 浸潤。
features: Sheet of predominantly small to intermediate lymphoid cells, about 1-1.5 times red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with coarsely clumped, block-like (soccer-ball) chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous in most cells
Occasional larger cell (lower right) and a granulated cell (upper right) within the infiltrate
Several crushed/smudged nuclei in the cluster
2049.describe_en: Smear (likely bone marrow aspirate or touch preparation) shows a dense cellular aggregate composed predominantly of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, scant pale cytoplasm, round to slightly irregular nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli. Occasional larger cells and scattered crushed nuclei are present, along with a rare granulated cell. Findings are consistent with involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD5+, CD23+, dim sIg).

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells are often more irregular/cleaved with finer chromatin and lack the block-like chromatin, and are CD23 negative with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.
Marginal zone cells have more abundant pale cytoplasm and may show plasmacytoid differentiation, and are typically CD5 and CD23 negative.
Follicular lymphoma cells have angulated, cleaved (buttock-like) nuclei and are CD10 and BCL6 positive, CD5 negative.
Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous with mixed T and B cells and lack a light chain-restricted CD5+/CD23+ population on flow cytometry.

1857.recognize_zh: 視野中幾乎全是大小相近的胚細胞，核質比極高、細胞質極少，染色質細緻至略顆粒狀，部分核有凹痕或不規則形狀，無顆粒與 Auer 小體，符合淋巴母細胞白血病；T 系需以流式確認。
features: Monotonous sheet of small to medium blasts
Very high N:C ratio with scant to barely visible cytoplasm
Finely stippled to slightly coarse chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Round to irregular nuclei, some with indentations or folds
Absence of granules and Auer rods; rare small mature lymphocytes and a nucleated red cell
1857.describe_en: Smear shows a monotonous population of small to medium-sized blasts with a very high N:C ratio, scant agranular cytoplasm, finely stippled chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Some nuclei are irregular with shallow indentations. Occasional small mature lymphocytes and a nucleated red cell are present, and Auer rods are absent. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, compatible with T-lymphoblastic leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (cytoplasmic CD3+, TdT+).

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps completely, and lineage requires flow cytometry showing CD19/CD79a/CD10 rather than cytoplasmic CD3/CD7.
Myeloblasts are usually larger with more cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli, occasional granules or Auer rods and MPO positivity.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and are surface immunoglobulin positive and TdT negative.

1473.recognize_zh: 這是 RT-PCR 洋菜膠電泳圖，每一 lane 上方都有 RNA 內部對照帶；病人檢體（粉紅箭頭）的 BCR::ABL1 產物帶與 b2a2（e13a2）陽性對照同高，而較高的條帶則對應 b3a2（e14a2），據此判讀病人為 b2a2 型融合轉錄本。
features: Agarose gel electrophoresis of RT-PCR products with lanes labeled B2 (b2a2 control), 1-8 and B3 (b3a2 control)
Upper internal RNA control band present in sample lanes, confirming RNA integrity
Lanes 1-4 show a band at the higher b3a2-size position
Lanes 5-6 lack a specific BCR::ABL1 band, showing only faint low-molecular-weight bands
