Patient sample lane (arrow) and lane 8 show a band co-migrating with the b2a2 control
1473.describe_en: Agarose gel of RT-PCR products for BCR::ABL1 transcripts shows an upper internal RNA control band in the sample lanes, confirming amplifiable RNA. The patient sample, indicated by the arrow, shows a specific product co-migrating with the b2a2 (e13a2) positive control, which runs lower than the b3a2 (e14a2) control. Lanes 1-4 show a b3a2-size product and lanes 5-6 show no specific band. The result indicates a p210 BCR::ABL1 fusion transcript of the e13a2 (b2a2) type, consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia in the appropriate clinical context.

60929.recognize_zh: 中央一群十多個緊密聚集、各自帶紫色顆粒中心的小血小板，旁邊還有一片淡灰色攤開的血小板物質，這就是血小板凝集（platelet clump），會造成自動計數假性血小板低下。
features: Aggregate of approximately 15 individual platelets clustered together in the center
Each platelet shows a purple granular center (granulomere) with pale hyalomere, some with fine pseudopods
Adjacent pale grey, flattened, sheet-like structure, likely a spread/degranulated platelet or platelet material
A few single platelets scattered nearby
Background red cells with some crenated (echinocytic) forms, likely artifactual
60929.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a central aggregate of approximately fifteen platelets, each with a purple granular center, adjacent to a pale grey flattened sheet of spread platelet material. A few single platelets are present nearby, and the background red cells include occasional crenated forms. No fibrin strands or leukocyte involvement are appreciated. Findings are consistent with platelet clumping, which can cause spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counts; review of the feathered edge and a repeat count in a citrate tube are recommended.

ddx.vs: In satellitism, platelets form a rosette around the periphery of neutrophils rather than an isolated free aggregate.
A giant platelet is a single large platelet with one continuous outline, not multiple discrete granulomeres.
Megakaryocytic cells or fragments contain nuclear material, whereas this aggregate is composed entirely of anucleate platelets.

65.recognize_zh: 血液與骨髓抹片見大量高核質比、染色質細緻的芽細胞，骨髓切片幾乎被芽細胞填滿；流式細胞儀顯示 CD45 弱陽性、CD19/CD10/cCD79a 陽性的 B 淋巴芽細胞，且 CRLF2 表面表現陽性（76.72%），提示 BCR-ABL1-like B-ALL；但型態本身無法區分亞型，需分子檢查確認。
features: Blood and aspirate: numerous medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular blue cytoplasm; occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles

Bone marrow biopsy: hypercellular marrow with near-total replacement by sheets of monotonous blasts with round to irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, and scattered mitoses; normal hematopoiesis markedly reduced
Flow CD45 vs SSC: dim-to-negative CD45, low side-scatter blast population comprising 82.39% of events
Blasts CD19+, CD10 bright+, cCD79a+, cCD22 dim/partial, CD34 variable (dim to positive), CD38 bright, CD20 mostly negative to partial
Surface CRLF2 expressed on 76.72% of gated blasts, shifted relative to the residual normal population
No Auer rods, cytoplasmic granules, or morphologic lineage-specific features
65.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears show numerous circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate is dominated by similar blasts, some with fine cytoplasmic vacuoles, and the core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow almost entirely replaced by sheets of monotonous blasts with frequent mitotic figures and marked reduction of residual hematopoiesis. Flow cytometry identifies a CD45 dim-to-negative, low side-scatter blast population (82.39%) expressing CD19, bright CD10, cytoplasmic CD79a, dim cytoplasmic CD22, bright CD38, and variable CD34, with CD20 largely negative, and aberrant surface CRLF2 expression on 76.72% of blasts. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia; CRLF2 overexpression supports a CRLF2-rearranged BCR-ABL1-like (Ph-like) subtype, which requires molecular confirmation and exclusion of BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: Morphology and immunophenotype overlap (CD25/myeloid antigen coexpression can occur), so BCR::ABL1 FISH/RT-PCR is required to distinguish it from Ph-like ALL.
Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum of CD34, CD10, CD20 and CD38 with normal CD45 and no CRLF2 aberrancy, unlike this monotonous aberrant blast population.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts may look identical but lack CD19/cCD79a/CD10 and express myeloid markers such as MPO, CD13, and CD33.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are surface immunoglobulin-positive, TdT/CD34-negative with MYC rearrangement.

captions: Peripheral blood: several blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and scant blue cytoplasm.
Peripheral blood: large blasts beside a small mature lymphocyte for size comparison.
Bone marrow biopsy (H&E): marrow packed with sheets of blasts adjacent to a bone trabecula, with mitoses.
Bone marrow biopsy (H&E), high power: monotonous blasts with fine chromatin and scattered mitotic figures.
Bone marrow aspirate: sheets of blasts, some with fine cytoplasmic vacuoles.
Flow CD45 vs SSC: CD45 dim/negative, low-SSC blast gate at 82.39%.
Flow CD19 vs CD34: CD19-positive blasts (red) with variable CD34 compared with CD34-negative mature B cells (purple).
Flow cCD79a vs cCD22: blasts cytoplasmic CD79a positive with dim cCD22.
Flow CD20 vs CD10: blasts bright CD10 with CD20 negative to partial, separate from mature CD10-negative B cells.
Flow CD58 vs CD10: CD10-bright blasts express CD58.
Flow CD38 vs CD34: blasts bright CD38 with variable CD34.
Flow histogram: surface CRLF2 expressed on 76.72% of gated blasts.

129.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被單一型態、中等大小的淋巴球瀰漫性取代，細胞核略不規則、染色質細緻，部分有明顯核仁與核分裂（多形性變異型的線索）；免疫染色可見瀰漫性強核染色（符合 cyclin D1／SOX11／p53 類型）及偏高的增生指數，支持具不良預後特徵的被套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）。
features: Diffuse effacement of nodal architecture by a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate around a hyalinized vessel
Medium-sized to larger cells with slightly irregular/cleaved nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small but distinct nucleoli in a subset (pleomorphic features)
Scant pale cytoplasm; scattered mitotic figures; occasional pink histiocytes
Touch imprint: sheets of monotonous medium-to-large cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli

IHC: diffuse strong membranous B-cell-type staining, diffuse strong nuclear staining in most tumor cells, and a proliferation-type nuclear stain positive in a substantial fraction (stains not labeled on images)
Scattered granular-cytoplasm positive background cells on one stain, with tumor cells negative
129.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show diffuse effacement of the architecture by a monotonous proliferation of lymphoid cells surrounding a hyalinized vessel. At high power the cells are medium to large, with slightly irregular nuclear contours, finely dispersed chromatin, small distinct nucleoli in a subset and scant cytoplasm; mitotic figures are readily found, and a touch imprint shows a corresponding population of monotonous blastoid-to-pleomorphic cells. Immunohistochemical stains (not labeled on the images) show diffuse membranous positivity in the neoplastic cells, diffuse strong nuclear positivity in the majority of cells, and a nuclear proliferation stain highlighting a substantial fraction of cells, with scattered non-neoplastic reactive cells. In the context of cyclin D1 and SOX11 expression with p53 overexpression and Ki-67 >30%, the findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with pleomorphic features and adverse prognostic markers.

ddx.vs: Pleomorphic MCL can mimic DLBCL morphologically, but MCL is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive with t(11;14), whereas DLBCL is cyclin D1 negative (or only weak in rare CD5+ cases) and SOX11 negative.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with proliferation centers
ddx.vs: CLL/SLL shows small round cells with clumped chromatin, paler proliferation centers with paraimmunoblasts, CD23 and LEF1 positivity, and lacks cyclin D1 and SOX11.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma expresses TdT (and often CD34) and lacks cyclin D1, while blastoid MCL is TdT negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.

ddx.dx: Cyclin D1-positive plasma cell neoplasm or hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These may express cyclin D1 but differ in morphology (plasmacytoid cells or abundant cytoplasm with hairy projections), are SOX11 negative, and have distinct immunophenotypes (CD138 or CD103/CD25/annexin A1).

captions: Touch imprint: sheets of monotonous medium-to-large lymphoid cells with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
H&E low power: diffuse effacement of the lymph node around a hyalinized vessel
H&E high power: medium-to-large cells with irregular nuclei, distinct nucleoli and a mitotic figure (pleomorphic features)
IHC (unlabeled): diffuse strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining of tumor cells
IHC (unlabeled): scattered strongly positive non-neoplastic cells with granular cytoplasmic staining; tumor cells negative
IHC (unlabeled): diffuse membranous staining of tumor cells
IHC (unlabeled): nuclear staining in scattered clustered cells, likely proliferation marker
IHC (unlabeled): weak-to-moderate nuclear staining in most tumor cells
IHC (unlabeled): strong nuclear staining in a substantial fraction of cells around a vessel, likely Ki-67
IHC (unlabeled): diffuse strong nuclear staining in nearly all tumor cells (cyclin D1/SOX11/p53 pattern)
IHC (unlabeled): diffuse strong membranous staining of tumor cells, likely a pan-B-cell marker

65921.recognize_zh: 薄層血液抹片中有兩個瘧原蟲裂殖體（schizont）：右上方一個在藍色細胞質內含約 8 個分散的紫紅色染色質點（merozoite），中央一個則是更緻密、塞滿染色質顆粒的成熟裂殖體；但被感染紅血球未見明顯變大，也看不到 Schüffner 小點，種別無法僅憑本圖確認為間日瘧（P. vivax）。
features: Two intraerythrocytic parasites with multiple discrete magenta chromatin dots (merozoites), consistent with schizonts
Upper parasite: about 8 separate chromatin dots within blue parasite cytoplasm, an early-to-mid schizont
Central parasite: densely packed merozoites filling the parasite with dark granular material, a mature schizont; merozoites too crowded to count reliably
Host red cells are not appreciably enlarged and Schüffner stippling is not seen at this magnification
Background erythrocytes show crenated (echinocytic) and irregular forms, likely drying artifact; scattered platelets
65921.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows two intraerythrocytic malaria parasites at the schizont stage, one containing approximately eight discrete chromatin dots in blue cytoplasm and the other a mature schizont densely filled with merozoites. The infected red cells do not appear enlarged relative to surrounding erythrocytes, and Schüffner stippling is not evident; background red cells show crenation artifact. Because the classic P. vivax features of host-cell enlargement, stippling and 12-24 merozoites cannot be confirmed in this field, species assignment should rely on the full smear, other stages and PCR or antigen testing. Findings are consistent with malarial schizonts, compatible with but not specific for Plasmodium vivax.

ddx.vs: P. malariae schizonts have 6-12 merozoites often in a rosette with coarse central pigment in normal-sized or small red cells without stippling.
P. falciparum schizonts are rarely seen in peripheral blood and are accompanied by many small delicate rings, multiply infected cells and crescent-shaped gametocytes.
P. ovale has 6-14 merozoites in enlarged oval red cells with fimbriated edges and prominent Schüffner (James) dots.
A superimposed platelet shows fine azurophilic granules in a pale gray matrix without discrete chromatin dots in blue parasite cytoplasm and lies in a different focal plane.

3585.recognize_zh: 中大型淋巴球，核圓、偏向一側、染色質凝集，胞質豐富淡藍，其中散布數顆清楚的紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules）；這就是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）的典型樣子。
features: Intermediate to large lymphocyte, about twice the diameter of a red cell
Round, eccentric nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Several discrete, coarse red-purple azurophilic granules clustered in the cytoplasm
Normal-appearing surrounding red cells
3585.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with a round, eccentrically placed nucleus with condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing several coarse azurophilic granules. No nucleolus is seen, and the surrounding erythrocytes are unremarkable. This is a large granular lymphocyte, representing a cytotoxic T cell or NK cell. A persistent absolute LGL count above 2 x 10^9/L (or lower with cytopenias) would warrant flow cytometry and T-cell receptor clonality testing to evaluate for T-LGL leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have abundant basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and generally lack discrete azurophilic granules.
Myeloid precursors have more numerous primary granules, a less condensed nucleus often with a paranuclear hof or nucleolus, and are MPO-positive.
Monocytes have a folded nucleus with lacy chromatin, gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and fine dust-like granules.
